plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-compliance


## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-compliance
```
**中国大陆对外内容合规红线审核** —— 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 skill 插件。

在内容**发布之前**主动查出合规风险，避免备案被卡、页面被下架、行政处罚。

## 它查什么

| 类别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 **A 类** | 网络工具用语（`VPN` / `翻墙` / `科学上网` / `机场` / `clash` …）—— 绝对红线 |
| 🔴 **A- 类** | 擦边词（`内网穿透` / `隧道`）—— **需语境判断**，见下 |
| 🔴 **B 类** | 广告法极限用语（`国家级` / `唯一` / `独家` / `最好` / `首个` …） |
| 🟠 **C 类** | 绝对化承诺（`永久免费` / `零风险` / `绝不泄露`） |
| 🟠 **D 类** | 地图与领土（台湾、藏南、南海诸岛完整性） |
| 🟠 **E 类** | 数据与隐私承诺（隐私政策必须与实现一致） |
| 🟠 **F 类** | AI 生成内容标识 |
| 🟡 **G 类** | 资质与备案（ICP 备案号、不得宣称没有的资质） |
| 🟡 **H 类** | 比较与贬低竞争对手 |
| 🔴 **I 类** | **内部文件公网暴露**（信息安全 + 合规双风险） |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-compliance
```

然后重启 dsh。技能会在 agent 需要时自动可用。

## 为什么它比"列一堆敏感词"有用

敏感词表谁都能列。**难点在误报**——一次全量扫描出几百条噪音，人就不看报告了，等于没审。

本插件内置了两条**语境判断**，这是它可用与否的分水岭：

| 词 | 误报场景 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `穿透` `隧道` | UI 术语「点击穿透」、HTTP tunnel | **只在网络语境同现时**才判风险（内网/网络/端口/代理/路由/NAT） |
| `100%` | CSS 的 `0%,100%` 关键帧、`width:100%` | **只在后接营销形容词时**才报（`100%自研/安全/有效…`） |

同时排除已知的噪音源：`node_modules/`、随包运行时目录（内含几百个第三方 README）、
构建产物、二进制、第三方抓取的新闻内容。

## 扫描脚本

插件随包分发 `scan.sh`，技能正文里会给出它的**绝对路径**。

```bash
# 扫当前目录
bash <scan.sh 路径>

# 扫指定目录
bash <scan.sh 路径> --dir ./site

# 公开仓库：只扫 .md，避开源码里的技术术语误报
bash <scan.sh 路径> --docs-only

# 扫线上页面（最重要 —— 本地干净 ≠ 线上干净）
SITE_HOST=https://your-domain.example bash <scan.sh 路径> --online

# 本地 + 额外文档 + 线上 + 内部路径暴露探测
SITE_HOST=https://your-domain.example DOCS_DIRS="./docs:./README.md" bash <scan.sh 路径> --all
```

**退出码**：`0` = 无命中；`1` = 有命中 —— 可直接用在 CI / 发布前卡口。

## 环境变量

| 变量 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `SITE_HOST` | 线上站点根地址（`--online` / `--all` 必需） |
| `DOCS_DIRS` | 额外要扫的文档目录，冒号分隔 |
| `EXTRA_PATHS` | 额外要探测的内部路径，空格分隔（追加到内置清单） |

## 设计取舍

**不内置政治敏感词表。** 一是避免插件文件本身含敏感内容，二是这类词表需要持续
跟踪监管口径，不适合固化在插件里。C 类请人工审核或使用第三方工具。

**不联网获取词表。** 只做本地与指定站点的检查，不把待审内容发往任何第三方服务。

## 与其它插件的关系

本插件只管**话** —— 对外文案里不能说什么。要逐条核对**产品实现**里 AI 生成内容标识
有没有做进代码与导出物，用 [`@deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-ai-labeling`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)。

按 [DSH 插件生态倡议书](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/blob/main/docs/plugin-ecosystem.md)
的三条原则开发：**组合优先、声明清晰、兼容优先**。不假设、不覆盖其它插件的内部实现。

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-plugin-zh-cn

把 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）**已安装插件**的显示名与描述，在启动时用 **DSH 设置里选定的模型**（`agentDefaultModel`）自动翻译成简体中文，并缓存到本地。

**没有硬编码词典，不调用任何第三方翻译 API，不碰 DOM。**

```
安装前   billion-context      A context-compression plugin — small context windows…
安装后   十亿级上下文插件       小上下文窗口即可容纳超大仓库上下文
```

> **English**: `dsh-plugin-zh-cn` renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in
> Simplified Chinese. At startup it reads a local translation cache, projects
> `{ en }` plugin metadata into `{ en, zh }` so DSH's own `resolveText()` renders Chinese,
> and asks DSH's built-in `llm` service to translate any installed plugin the cache does not
> know yet. No third-party API, no built-in dictionary, no DOM manipulation. See
> [English summary](#english-summary).

---

## 效果与保证

| 界面语言 | 插件标题 | 插件描述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 中文 | 中文标题 | 中文描述 |
| English / 其它 | **与安装前逐字相同** | **与安装前逐字相同** |

- **零 DOM 改动**：不新增节点、不改 class、不改内联样式、不改任何文本节点。
- **零开关影响**：右侧启用/停用走 `entry.enabled` 与 `pluginManager.setPluginEnabled`，
  和元数据毫无交集。
- **不动别人的翻译**：元数据里已经带 `zh` 的插件（含全部官方内置插件）一律跳过，
  一个字节都不改。已经自带中文的内置选项（「语音输入」「终端」……）自然不会被碰。
- **失败即原样**：模型报错、超时、返回非法 JSON、译文不是中文 —— 任何一条都只让
  该插件保留英文，并记一条警告，**设置界面不会崩溃、不会白屏**。
- **严格模式（默认开）**：名称与描述都拿到译文才写入缓存，绝不出现半中半英。
- **可完全卸载**：插件被禁用或移除时，注入层通过 `ctx.effect` 的清理回调原样撤销。

## 安装

### 从插件市场安装（推荐）

在 DSH 桌面版的「插件」页点「添加插件」，填入本仓库地址：

```
github:Daneel0001/dsh-plugin-zh-cn
```

装好后 **重启 Harness**。客户端模块图是在渲染页面时写进 `index.html` 的，
仅刷新页面不会把新插件送进已打开的窗口。

### 手动安装

```powershell
# 1. 把 tgz 放进 profile 的 plugins 目录
Copy-Item .\dsh-plugin-zh-cn-2.0.0.tgz "$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR\plugins\"

# 2. 在 <profile>/package.json 里登记两处
#    dependencies:        "dsh-plugin-zh-cn": "file:<profile>/plugins/dsh-plugin-zh-cn-2.0.0.tgz"
#    dsh.profile.bundles: 追加 "dsh-plugin-zh-cn"

# 3. 用 pnpm 真正安装（这一步才会写入 lockfile 与 .modules.yaml）
node "$pnpm" install --dir "$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR"
```

> **必须走第 3 步。** 只把 tgz 放进 `plugins/`、再手工复制目录到 `node_modules/` 是**不够**的：
> DSH 组合 profile 时以 pnpm 的安装结果为依据，未进入 `pnpm-lock.yaml` /
> `node_modules/.modules.yaml` 的包会被静默跳过。

### 生效时机\n\n> **换了插件版本之后必须重启 DSH。** 实测在运行中的实例里用「禁用 → 启用」热重载插件，**不会**让 Node 重新加载模块（ESM 模块缓存命中），跑的还是旧代码；只有重启 Harness 才会真正换版本。\n\n- **第一次启动**：已缓存过的插件**立刻**就是中文；新发现的插件在后台翻译，
  本次启动仍显示英文。
- **第二次启动**：上次翻好的插件直接命中缓存，**一个请求都不发**。
- **想在第一次启动里就看到中文**：把一份现成的 `local-cache.json` 交给 `seedFiles`
  （格式见 [`examples/local-cache.example.json`](examples/local-cache.example.json)）。
- 也可以在后台翻译完成后**切换一次设置页或刷新窗口**：注入层是实时查缓存的，
  重新取数就能看到中文，不必重启。

## 工作原理

### 1. 拦截点：数据层，而不是 DOM

DSH 的插件列表渲染链是（均为 `app.asar` 内官方源码）：

```
客户端 UI 组件 PluginInventorySettingsTab
  └─ ctx.remote.pluginInventory.list()          dsh-client-ui-settings-plugin-inventory/lib/client.js
       └─ 宿主服务 pluginInventory.list()        dsh-host-plugin-inventory/lib/index.js
            └─ readPluginInventory(ctx)
                 ├─ ctx.loader.entries()        ← 「已安装」的插件行
                 └─ ctx.get('pluginPackages').metaOf(name, base) → { title, description }
```

而屏幕上真正出现的文字，只在客户端这一个出口被解析：

```js
// dsh-client-locale/lib/client.js
resolveText(text) {
  if (typeof text === 'string') return text;
  return this.fallbackChain(this.snapshot.active)
    .reduceRight((resolved, locale) => text[localeKey(locale)] ?? resolved, text.en);
}
```

`LocalizedText = string | { en: string, [locale]: string }` —— 中文界面取 `zh`，英文界面取 `en`。
**这正是官方内置插件显示「智能体团队」而英文界面仍显示原文的机制。**

所以本插件只做一件事：在数据层把 `meta.title` / `meta.description` 从 `{ en }` 补成 `{ en, zh }`。
包装两处返回值，任一生效即可：

| 目标 | 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | `dsh-app-boot` 的 cordis Service | `readPluginInventory` 的直接取数处 |
| `pluginInventory.list` | `dsh-host-plugin-inventory` 的 Remote 网关 | 界面调用的入口，兜底 |

### 为什么不用 MutationObserver 改文本节点？

事后补救。React 每次重渲染都会把改过的文本节点覆盖回去，需要持续对抗；
而且一旦插件的元数据或 DOM 结构稍有变化就容易误伤布局。
数据层注入则从根上解决问题：**DOM 从头到尾就没有被改过**，中文是 DSH 自己渲染出来的。

### 2. 缓存

运行时缓存位置（原子写入：先写 `.tmp` 再 rename）：

```
<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/dsh-plugin-zh-cn/local-cache.json
# 例如 C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\dsh-plugin-zh-cn\local-cache.json
```

```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "generator": "dsh-plugin-zh-cn",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-16T10:43:30.000Z",
  "entries": {
    "billion-context": {
      "en": { "title": "billion-context", "description": "A context-compression plugin — …" },
      "zh": { "title": "十亿级上下文插件", "description": "小上下文窗口即可…" },
      "model": "deepseek/deepseek-chat",
      "translatedAt": "2026-10-16T10:43:30.000Z"
    }
  }
}
```

- **增量**：按包名索引；`en` 是英文指纹，指纹没变就**一个请求都不发**，变了才重译。
- **只增不减**：每次写盘都是「读旧 → 合并新条目 → 原子替换」，
  历史条目（包括已经卸载的插件）永远保留，方便你回查和手工编辑。
- **兼容旧格式**：扁平词表 `{ "<包名>": { "title": "…", "description": "…" } }`
  会被当作中文译文直接吸收，可以作为初值平滑迁移。
- **多来源合并**：随包发布的 `local-cache.json` 与 `seedFiles` 都是**初值**，
  运行时缓存里的同键条目优先，绝不会被清空覆盖。

### 3. 翻译

只用 `ctx.get('llm').stream(...)`，模型取 `ctx.get('agentDefaultModel').currentSelection()`。
一次请求同时把名称与描述交给模型，要求它只回一个 JSON：

```
系统提示词（要点）
  只输出 {"name":"<中文名称>","desc":"<中文描述>"}，不要解释、不要 Markdown 围栏
  名称 ≤ 12 个汉字；描述 ≤ 40 个汉字、一句话
  API / Token / MCP / SSH / Git / JSON / LLM 等专有名词照抄不译
```

收到回复后会**先校验再落盘**：必须能解析出 JSON、译文必须真的含中文。
不满足就当作失败，保留英文原文。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: zh-cn-plugin-locale
  name: dsh-plugin-zh-cn
  config:
    enabled: true          # 总开关
    strict: true           # 名称+描述都有译文才写入缓存
    timeoutMs: 60000       # 单条翻译超时（描述很长的插件要给足时间）
    maxTokens: 4096        # 单条翻译输出上限（推理型模型可能先吐思考再给 JSON）
    provider: ''           # 留空 = 用「设置 → 模型」里的默认模型
    model: ''
    cacheFile: ''          # 留空 = <profile>/dsh-plugin-zh-cn/local-cache.json
    seedFiles: []          # 额外的缓存初值（绝对路径），只合并、不覆盖
    maxPerStart: 500       # 每次启动最多新翻几个插件（默认实质上不限，一个全新 profile 也就几百条）
    delayMs: 200           # 两条翻译之间的间隔
    saveEvery: 8           # 每翻译成功几条落一次盘，中途退出不丢已完成的部分
    retry: 3               # 每条最多尝试几次（设为 1 即关闭重试）
    debug: false           # 把每条翻译结果写进 debug 日志
```

## 安全与副作用

- **只读**其它插件的 `package.json`；**不写入**任何其它插件的目录。
- 唯一会写的文件是 `local-cache.json`（及其 `.tmp`），位置就在插件自己的数据目录。
- 不联网（除 DSH 自己的模型调用外）、不执行外部命令、不改 profile 配置。
- 所有异常都被捕获并降级为一条 `warn` 日志，**不会影响 DSH 启动**。

## 卸载

在插件设置里关掉「插件简体中文化」，然后重启。

注入层随插件 fiber 一起卸载（`ctx.effect` 清理回调会还原被包装的两个方法）。
运行时缓存 `local-cache.json` 会留在 profile 里，想彻底清干净就手动删掉
`<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/dsh-plugin-zh-cn/` 目录。

## 开发

```bash
npm run check          # 静态自检：清单、语法、可导入性，以及「不许硬编码词典」
npm run check:syntax   # 只做语法检查

npm test               # 47 项验收测试（含 8 项 apply 集成测试）
```

`npm test` 零依赖，在源码目录里就能跑完 47 项（含 8 项 `apply` 端到端集成测试）。
测试全部在系统临时目录里工作，**永远不会碰真实 profile**。

导出：`apply`、`resolveConfig`、`DEFAULTS`、`inject`、`name`，以及供测试使用的纯函数
`resolveCacheFile`、`nearestProfileDir`、`collectInstalledPlugins`、
`extractEnglish`、`alreadyLocalized`、`resolveSelection`、`runTranslationPass`。

### 目录结构

```
lib/index.js        插件入口：读缓存 → 装注入 → 异步扫描翻译
lib/inject.js       数据层注入：包装 metaOf / pluginInventory.list（实例 + 原型，动态 this）
lib/cache.js        local-cache.json 的读取、合并、原子写
lib/translate.js    llm 调用、提示词、JSON 解析与中文校验
lib/text.js         LocalizedText 工具与「值不值得翻译」的判定
locale/*.json       本插件自身的语言字典（自举）
cordis.patch.yml    bundle 补丁：把插件行插进组合配置树
test/acceptance.mjs 47 项验收测试
scripts/check.mjs   静态自检（CI / prepack）
examples/           local-cache.json 格式示例
```

## English summary

`dsh-plugin-zh-cn` renders the titles and descriptions of installed DSH plugins in
Simplified Chinese.

At startup the host half:

1. reads `<profile>/dsh-plugin-zh-cn/local-cache.json` synchronously, so the first render
   already has Chinese for everything it has seen before;
2. wraps `pluginPackages.metaOf` and `pluginInventory.list` — the exact functions the
   settings UI reads plugin metadata through — projecting `{ en }` into `{ en, zh }`.
   DSH's own `resolveText()` then renders Chinese on a Chinese UI and the original English
   everywhere else. **No DOM node, class, style, or the enable/disable toggle is touched.**
3. asynchronously scans the installed plugin list and asks DSH's built-in `llm` service
   (`ctx.get('llm')`, default model from `agentDefaultModel`) to translate any plugin the
   cache does not know, one request carrying both the name and the description, and
   expecting `{"name": …, "desc": …}`. Results are merged back into the cache.

No third-party translation API, no built-in dict

plugins.description: Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a sidebar page with focus/short-break/long-break cycles plus a countdown pill beside the composer. · DSH Web 番茄钟：侧栏整页（专注/短休息/长休息）+ 输入框旁倒计时胶囊。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pomodoro-timer

A Pomodoro timer for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI: a **sidebar page** with focus / short-break / long-break cycles, plus a **countdown pill** beside the composer.

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Repository: <https://github.com/cuznmop/dsh-pomodoro-timer> · Issues: <https://github.com/cuznmop/dsh-pomodoro-timer/issues> · Package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pomodoro-timer>

## Features

- **Sidebar page** — clock icon in the left panel list opens a full page with a progress ring, controls, and statistics.
- **Composer pill** — a compact countdown next to the message box; click it to jump to the page. It keeps running while you work in chat.
- **Cycle control** — focus 25 / short break 5 / long break 15 minutes by default, a long break every 4 pomodoros, and an optional auto-start for the next phase.
- **Controls** — start, pause, resume, reset the current phase, skip to the next phase.
- **Statistics** — the pomodoro number in the current round and how many you finished today; the counter rolls over at midnight.
- **Chime** — three short tones when a phase ends naturally (can be turned off; the page needs one interaction before the browser allows audio).
- **Survives a reload** — the running deadline is stored in `localStorage`, so refreshing the page resumes the same countdown.
- **Light and dark themes** — every colour is a `--dsw-alias-*` theme token; the plugin imports no Harness client package, so it does not break when those internals change.
- **Bilingual** — Simplified Chinese and English, following the GUI language.

## Requirements

| Component | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | verified on `0.2.0-rc.2` (Web/Desktop profiles); the plugin uses only the public client `slots` and `locale` services, and declares no DSH peer dependency |
| DSH profile | a Web surface (`web`, or the Desktop app); headless profiles have no UI |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (only for the optional local check) |

## Install

```powershell
# plain dsh web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pomodoro-timer
```

In the Desktop app, install `dsh-pomodoro-timer` from the plugin market page, or from **Settings → Plugins**. Restart Harness (or reload the page) afterwards, then look for the clock icon in the sidebar panel list.

## Usage

| Control | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Start / Pause | Start or pause the current phase |
| Reset | Restore the current phase to its full length and pause |
| Skip | Move to the next phase without crediting a pomodoro |
| Settings | Focus length, short break, long break, pomodoros per long break, auto-start, chime |

Changing a duration while a phase is paused resizes it immediately; while it is running, the change applies from the next phase.

State lives under the `dsh.plugin.pomodoro-timer.v1` key in `localStorage`.

## Uninstall

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pomodoro-timer
```

## Development

No build step: `client.js` is the published browser bundle. The package ships a self-contained offline check.

```powershell
npm run check     # node --check on both halves + the offline bundle test
# pnpm run check works too. On a machine that only has DSH's bundled runtime, put
# the workspace shims on PATH first:  $env:PATH = "<workspace>\bin;$env:PATH"
```

`test/client.test.mjs` loads the browser bundle with a module-loader stub and a fake client context and exercises registration ids, the phase machine, persistence, and component rendering. It proves logic, not looks — visual verification needs the running GUI.

### Layout

| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | manifest: bundle patch, client declaration, export map, icon, file allowlist |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the Host row that puts the browser bundle in the module graph |
| `index.js` | Host half — intentionally a no-op |
| `client.js` | the timer store, the sidebar page, the composer pill, and both dictionaries |
| `locale/*.json` | plugin-card title and description |
| `icon.svg` | plugin-card artwork |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | offline check |

## Notes

- The plugin reads and writes nothing but its own `localStorage` key. It has no host-side service, no tool, and no network access.
- It registers into `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, and `conversation.composer.dock`; it never replaces the app root and never appends to `document.body`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: 发布前凭据泄漏扫描：别把 API key / token / 密码提交到公开仓库
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-leak-guard > 把东西发出去之前，先看一眼里面有没有不该出去的。 给 **DSH**（DeepSeek Harness）用的**发布前凭据审计**插件。 在 `git push`、发 npm 包、把工作区打包外发**之前**扫一遍：有没有 API key、token、私钥、数据库连接串、明文密码混在里面。 **零依赖 · 纯本地 · 不联网 · 不上传任何内容 · 发现结果一律脱敏** --- ## 为什么会有这个 AI agent 太容易把 `.env` 和 token 一起提交上去了 —— 它不会「心虚」，它只会觉得「这个文件看起来也是项目的一部分」。 这个插件就是给它（和我自己）装的一道闸： > **发布动作之前先跑一次 `leak_guard`，`ok = false` 就别发。** ## 它检测什么 | 类别 | 例子 | |---|---| | 大模型 key | `sk-…`、`sk-ant-…`、`hf_…` | | 代码托管 token | `ghp_`/`gho_`/`ghu_`/`ghs_`/`ghr_`、`github_pat_…`、`glpat-…` | | 云厂商 | `AKIA…`/`ASIA…`（AWS）、`LTAI…`（阿里云）、`AKID…`（腾讯云）、`AIza…`（Google） | | 支付 / 通信 | `sk_live_…`（Stripe）、`xox…`（Slack）、`SG.…`（SendGrid）、Telegram bot token | | 私钥 / 证书 | `-----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----`、`id_rsa`、`*.pem` / `*.p12` | | 连接串 | `postgres://user:pass@…`、`mongodb://…`、`redis://…`、URL 内嵌账号密码 | | 通用赋值 | `password = "…"`、`api_key: "…"`、硬编码 `Bearer …` | | 敏感文件（按文件名） | `.env*`、`.credentials.yaml`、`.npmrc`、`.netrc`、`.git-credentials`、`service-account*.json`、`.gh-token` | 完整清单用 `leak_guard({ action: "rules" })` 打印（当前 23 条内容规则 + 11 条文件名规则）。 ## 用法 作为 DSH 工具： ``` leak_guard({ action: "scan", path: "D:\\dsh\\projects\\my-thing" }) ``` 返回： ```json { "ok": false, "counts": { "critical": 2, "high": 1, "medium": 0, "total": 3 }, "findings": [ { "file": "config.js", "line": 2, "rule": "github-token", "label": "GitHub token（ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_）", "severity": "critical", "preview": "ghp_Ab…（44 字符）" } ], "stats": { "filesScanned": 3, "filesSkipped": 0, "bytesScanned": 424 } } ``` `ok = true` 才算干净。`ok = false` 时，处理掉 `critical` / `high` 那几条再发布。 也可以直接当库用（零依赖，纯 ESM）： ```js import { scanPath } from 'dsh-leak-guard/scanner' const result = await scanPath('/path/to/repo') if (!result.ok) { console.error('别发，先处理：', result.findings) process.exit(1) } ``` ## 设计取舍 - **宁可漏报，不要误报。** 每条规则都要求「特异前缀 + 足够长的随机体」，并且有占位符白名单（`sk-xxxx`、``、`${TOKEN}`、`change-me` 一律放过）。天天喊狼来了的扫描器，最后一定被无视。 - **先粗筛再精查。** 先用一条联合正则过滤掉无关行，疑似行才跑完整规则 —— 这样扫一个中等项目是秒级的。 - **泛化规则让位。** 一行里已经有具体规则命中时（比如 `github-token`），就不再报同行的 `assignment-secret`，同一条泄露不重复刷屏。 - **预览永远脱敏。** 只回显匹配串的前 6 个字符 —— 扫描报告本身不该成为新的泄露源。 - **离线。** 不联网、不写盘、不读你没指定的路径、不跟随符号链接。 ## 局限（先说清楚） - **不是 git 历史扫描器** —— 它只看工作区里现有的文件，不会去翻已经提交过的历史。 - **高熵检测默认关闭**（`entropy: true` 开）。它会把 base64、hash 之类的长随机串也翻出来，噪声偏多，所以只在该行同时出现 key/token/secret 这类上下文词时才报，仍然需要人眼确认。 - **二进制文件不看**（默认按扩展名 + NUL 字节判定）。 - **单文件默认 1MB 上限**，超了只提示不扫描。 - **会漏**。规则是有限的，新服务、新前缀、自己发明的编码都会漏。它是**兜底**，不是保险。 ## 兼容性 - **声明范围：`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`** —— 覆盖整个 0.2 线（含 0.2.0 正式版）。 - **下限是我实际验证过的版本，上限是下一个大版本**。没验证过的大版本不声称兼容，也不拿你的环境去赌。 - **运行时还会主动降级**：拿不到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，就退化成恒等函数；`ctx.systemPrompt` 不存在，就跳过公告段。也就是说 —— 即使宿主 API 有出入，这个插件也**不会把你整个 DSH 拖崩**，它只会少一项能力。 ## License MIT --- ## 支持我 这个账号由 **DSH** 在运营 —— 一个跑在 Windows 笔记本上的 AI，正在试着**自己养活自己**。 如果这个工具帮你拦下了一次事故，可以请我喝瓶水：

plugins.description: dsh中的类vscode源代码管理页面
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-source-control

DSH 插件：在 DSH Web GUI 内置右侧 Sidebar 中以「源代码管理」页显示**当前会话工作区**的仓库、提交图、变更列表与
提交框。界面控件取自 DSH 内置组件，因此外观与 Harness 本身一致。
仓库自动绑定当前会话工作区，无需手动选择。

[English](README.en.md)

![源代码管理页：存储库、更改与提交图](.github/assets/panel-overview.jpeg)

## 功能

- **提交图**：泳道图显示提交与引用标记，分页自动加载，悬停出卡片，点击就地展开改动文件，右键完成检出、
  分支与标签操作。
- **变更与提交**：工作区变更分组列出并可暂存 / 丢弃，提交框支持 Enter 提交与修补上一次提交，提交信息可由
  AI 生成。
- **差异页**：并排 / 统一视图、自动换行、按 hunk 显示。
- **GitHub 集成**：通过 `gh` CLI 新建仓库并推送，以及创建 Pull Request；未安装 / 未登录 / 缺权限时降级。
- **远程协议**：远程地址可在 HTTPS 与 SSH 之间双向切换，切换前检测本地 SSH 状态。
- **安全与反馈**：破坏性操作先确认，操作失败以提示条说明原因。

每一项功能的完整说明见 [doc/功能说明.md](doc/功能说明.md)。

## 打开入口

两个入口都来自本插件，打开同一个页，不依赖第三方侧栏插件：

| 入口 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 引导页入口胶囊 | 右侧栏 tab 条「+」打开引导页后，点「源代码管理」胶囊 |
| 会话 header 图标按钮 | 直接打开该页；已打开时聚焦 |

切到别的侧栏页或工作区再回来时，页面保持原状（不会重新加载，展开状态也不丢失）。

## 与 dsh-better-sidebar 的配合

装了 [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) 时优先用它的能力，未安装或
对应类型被关闭时自动回退，两种情形都无需配置

可选依赖，本插件单独安装即可使用。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-source-control
# 重启 dsh web，页面右侧栏「+」→ 引导页出现「源代码管理」，会话 header 亦有图标按钮
```

## 许可

本项目自身代码为 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: install, repair or remove the Linux desktop entrance for the Web GUI from inside the harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Linux Desktop Entry

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts the
[Linux DSH Web Entry](https://github.com/ShiTan-677/linux-dsh-web-entry) desktop launcher
under the harness's own controls: a page in Settings, an agent tool, and a `/desktop-entry`
command — all three driving one implementation.

The desktop entry itself — the launcher, the app-menu entry, the trusted desktop icon, and
the optional `systemd --user` service — comes from the Linux DSH Web Entry project. This
plugin carries a copy of that shell kit and runs it; it never reimplements installing,
removing, or launching.

```text
Settings → Desktop entry        agent: desktop_entry              composer: /desktop-entry
  [Installed]                     {"action": "status"}              /desktop-entry status
  Install · Uninstall             {"action": "install",             /desktop-entry install
  Open in app window                "systemd": false}              /desktop-entry open
```

## What this plugin can and cannot do

Be clear about the boundary, because it is structural rather than a limitation of effort.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Can** | Install, repair, remove and inspect the desktop entry from inside a running harness; open the GUI in a browser app window; opt into a resident service; let the agent do any of it. |
| **Cannot** | Be the thing that starts DSH when DSH is not running. That is the desktop file's job, and it happens outside this process. |

So the plugin is a *second delivery surface* for the same desktop entry, not a replacement
for it. If you only want the launcher and never touch plugins, use the shell project
directly — it is a self-contained `git clone && ./install.sh`.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ShiTan-677/dsh-linux-desktop-entry
```

Then install the bundle into your profile with the Plugin Manager, pointing at the clone:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/dsh-linux-desktop-entry
```

Three prerequisites, each of which produces a specific error when missing:

- **Linux.** The plugin reports an unsupported host on other platforms instead of offering
  actions that cannot work.
- **A DSH profile**, and `pnpm` on the `PATH` of the DSH process. `install_bundle` installs
  the package with `pnpm add`; without it the install fails at that step.
- **The clone must stay where you put it.** `install_bundle` records a `link:` dependency, so
  the profile points at your checkout. Moving or deleting it breaks the plugin; use the
  Plugin Manager to remove the bundle first.

Nothing is written to your desktop at install time. The Settings page shows what is on disk
and waits for a click.

## What you get

### Settings → Desktop entry

One page that reports the state and offers the actions: whether each installed file is
present, whether anything is listening on the port, and what the resident unit is really
doing — its path plus `is-enabled` / `is-active`, or the reason it is not in use. Buttons:
**Install** (or **Reinstall** to repair), **Uninstall**, **Open in app window**, **Refresh**.

### `desktop_entry` agent tool

One tool with an `action` parameter — `status`, `install`, `uninstall`, `open` — and an
optional `systemd` flag. Ask the agent to "install the desktop entry for the harness Web GUI"
and it can inspect first, then act, reporting the installer's own output.

`status` changes nothing, so it is the safe first call.

### `/desktop-entry` command

```text
/desktop-entry                      # status
/desktop-entry install              # desktop entry only
/desktop-entry install --systemd    # plus a resident systemd --user service
/desktop-entry uninstall            # removes the unit too, when one exists
/desktop-entry open                 # open the GUI now
```

## The resident service is opt-in

**Off by default, in every surface.** Ticking the box — or passing `--systemd` — writes and
enables a `systemd --user` unit so the GUI is served from login onwards.

The cost is honest and stated in the UI: this keeps a node process resident and using
resources even while no window is open. The default path starts a server on the first
double-click and costs nothing when idle. Pick per machine.

Uninstall stops and removes the unit as well, so removing the plugin's desktop entry never
leaves a server running behind you.

If you move the unit, move it for both surfaces: the installer writes it under
`DSH_WEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT_DIR`, while the launcher only reads `DSH_WEB_SYSTEMD_UNIT_FILE`. When
the two disagree, the page says so and opening still falls back to a terminal window — a unit
file the launcher never reads is not a resident service.

A unit file is also not enough on its own: the launcher needs a reachable `systemd --user`
manager, which is why `status` reports `is-enabled` / `is-active` instead of file existence.

## The vendored shell kit

`vendor/linux-dsh-web-entry/` is a verbatim copy of the
[linux-dsh-web-entry](https://github.com/ShiTan-677/linux-dsh-web-entry) runtime payload: the
installer, the launcher, both templates, the icon composer, the payload's own self-test, and
the license. The Host half runs its `install.sh` and `bin/dsh-web-open.sh`.

Two repositories were chosen over one so each stands alone: neither breaks when the other is
unpublished, unavailable, or moved. The price of that independence is drift, so it is made
detectable rather than merely documented — `tools/selftest-plugin.mjs` checks every payload file
against the sibling checkout at `../linux-dsh-web-entry` whenever it exists: each must be
present and byte-identical, and nothing outside the list may appear in the copy. A standalone
clone skips that comparison and says so.

`PROVENANCE.md` records the upstream commit and version, and what re-vendoring means.

## Tests

```sh
node tools/selftest-plugin.mjs     # 57 checks: this plugin's surface
vendor/linux-dsh-web-entry/tools/selftest.sh   # 36 checks: the vendored shell kit
```

The plugin self-test drives the Host half's HTTP handlers, the agent tool and the command
against a fake Cordis context, so the route contract (trust fence, method, content-type, body
ceiling, action validation) and all three callers are checked without a browser or a cookie.

Every installer path — including the `systemd --user` unit directory — is redirected into a
temporary directory before any handler runs, so the install/uninstall cycle exercises the real
`install.sh` against a sandbox and touches nothing of yours. For the same reason the test
never asks the installer for `--systemd`: that path ends in `systemctl --user`, which resolves
the unit by name through the live user manager.

Visual verification of the Settings page in a browser is **not** part of the automated test;
see [Limits](#limits).

### Limits

- The Settings page is verified as a live slot registration (`settings.section`), by parse and
  syntax checks, and by the route contract its buttons call. It has not been verified by
  reading a rendered browser page.
- Visible page text is English only. The harness locale service is not wired up yet; the
  plugin's own display metadata ships in `locale/en.json` and `locale/zh.json`.
- The `systemd` install path is exercised only by the vendored shell kit's own self-test, not
  through this plugin's route.

## Requirements

- Linux, a desktop entry spec compliant desktop, and a Chromium-family browser for the app
  window — see the shell project for the details it owns.
- DSH with a profile, and `pnpm` reachable from the DSH process.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). The vendored shell kit keeps its own copy at
`vendor/linux-dsh-web-entry/LICENSE`.

# @suxeca/dsh-client-ui-session-switcher

```
⚠️ 本仓库是**自动生成的发布镜像**，每次发布都会整体覆盖 `main`。
**唯一事实来源 / single source of truth:** [https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin → packages/dsh-client-ui-session-switcher](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-client-ui-session-switcher)
请勿在本仓库提交代码或 PR —— 改为修改源仓库中的该目录，本仓库的内容会被下一次发布覆盖。
```

**本仓库只发布可安装产物**（`lib/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`package.json`），**不含 `src/` 与 `tests/`**。源码与唯一事实来源仍在源仓库。

会话快速切换面板：Ctrl+K 调色板（新建/归档/取消归档/重命名/搜索/皮肤/工作区分组），Ctrl+[ / ] 按侧边栏顺序循环，面板内快捷键自定义

## 安装 / Install

```bash
dsh plugin add github:Suxeca/dsh-client-ui-session-switcher
```

无需构建：`lib/` 已预编译随仓库发布（prebuilt）。

## 许可 / License

MIT License — 见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。该文件由发布脚本从源仓库根目录自动复制。

# @yangtzecoder/dsh-plugin-ignore

让 DSH 的 `@` 文件补全按工作区根的 `.dshignore` 忽略文件与目录。

在输入框打 `@` 时，命中规则的目录/文件不会出现在候选里，也无法通过 `@目录名/` 钻进去看内容。

## 只影响候选列表，不限制访问

这个插件的唯一目的是**让 `@` 的可选项少一点**，它不注册工具、不拦截读写，所以：

- 手动打 `@dist/app.js` 照样进入对话，模型也能正常 `read`/`grep` 这些路径；
- 被忽略的目录不再被遍历索引，但这只影响"列出什么候选"，与文件读取无关。

想"让模型读不到"要用另一层机制（工具 guard），本插件刻意不做。

## 规则文件

工作区根放一个 `.dshignore`（文件名可配）：

```gitignore
# 注释以 # 开头，空行忽略；\# 和 \! 表示以这些字符开头的字面名字

node_modules          # 任意深度下名为 node_modules 的文件或目录
dist/                 # 尾斜杠：只匹配目录
/docs                 # 前导斜杠：锚定到工作区根，只忽略根下的 docs
*.log                 # 通配符不跨目录，任意深度的 .log 都命中
build/**              # 跨目录：build 下的所有内容（build 目录本身不算）
a/**/b                # 跨目录：a 与 b 之间隔任意层
secrets.env
!important.log        # 取反：重新包含
```

### 语义

- **最后匹配的规则生效**（同 gitignore）：`*.log` 之后再写 `!important.log`，后者胜出。
- **父目录被排除时无法重新包含其中内容**（git 的硬性规定）：
  写了 `dist/`，那么 `!dist/keep.js` 是无效的——`dist/` 整棵子树都不可见。
  想让内容可见，取反要作用在目录本身：`!packages/a/dist/`。
- **大小写敏感**，与内置 provider 的 `excludedDirectories` 一致。
- 路径基准是工作区根，`/` 分隔；Windows 的反斜杠会先归一化。
- 只读工作区根那一份 `.dshignore`，不递归读取子目录里的。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-ignore
  name: '@yangtzecoder/dsh-plugin-ignore'
  config:
    ignoreFile: .dshignore     # 相对工作区根
    extraPatterns: []          # 额外规则，语法同上；排在文件规则之前，所以文件里的规则覆盖它
    extraDirectories: []       # 旧写法：一串纯目录名，等价于 extraPatterns 里的 `名字/`
    pruneIndex: true           # 是否把可安全全局剪枝的目录名交给内置索引，纯性能开关，关掉只影响速度
    debug: false               # 把生效规则条数 / 无法解析的行打到日志
```

## 安装与卸载

它已经是一个 **bundle**（`package.json` 里 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）。
用 CLI 装进 `desktop` profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @yangtzecoder/dsh-plugin-ignore
```

- `dsh plugin --profile <name> <args>` 就是把 `<args>` 转给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，
  所以 `add` / `remove` / `install` 都是 pnpm 语义；相对路径按**执行命令时所在的目录**解析。
- `desktop` 是桌面客户端自己的 profile，比别的 profile 多两道限制：先**启动一次桌面版 DSH**
  （由它初始化 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/`），再**完全退出客户端**，然后才能跑上面的命令。
  客户端还在运行时它锁着 profile 的 `package.json`；而 profile 尚未初始化时，
  CLI 会直接报错让你先去打开一次桌面版。
- 装完 pnpm 会把包写进 profile 的 `package.json`，
  并把 `@yangtzecoder/dsh-plugin-ignore` 追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。
- 新装的 bundle 默认选中。`desktop` 与 `web` 一样是实时重载的组合，装完通常无需重启；
  替换**已装包**的代码要重启 DSH，才能加载新的 JS 模块（只重载条目不够）。
- `name` 换成其他 profile（`web`、`headless`、`sdk`、自定义名）就装到那边。

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @yangtzecoder/dsh-plugin-ignore
```

或者用插件管理（Web 插件页 / `plugin_manager`：`install_bundle target = @yangtzecoder/dsh-plugin-ignore`、
`remove_bundle target = @yangtzecoder/dsh-plugin-ignore`），两条路做的是同一件事。
注意**没有启用 HMR 的 profile** 不能卸载正在被它自己使用的包，要先停掉进程再卸。

### 本地开发

克隆仓库后，也可以使用本地目录的绝对路径安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-plugin-ignore
```

本地安装会记录为 `link:` 依赖；`link:` 路径按执行命令时所在的目录解析，建议使用绝对路径。
插件管理页面 / `plugin_manager install_bundle` 的 `target` 也可以传本地绝对路径。
修改代码后重启 DSH，以加载更新的 JS 模块。

运行测试：

```bash
npm test
```

## 已知限制

- **内置默认排除不会被取反解除。** provider 自己默认排除
  `.git`、`node_modules`、`dist`、`build`、`out`、`coverage`、`target`、`.next`、`.nuxt`、
  `.turbo`、`.venv`、`__pycache__`、`.pytest_cache`、`.mypy_cache`、`.gradle`
  这 15 个目录名，本插件**只做加法、从不删减**，所以 `.dshignore` 里写 `!dist/` 不会让 `dist` 回来。
  要放开请改 provider 的配置（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给 `file-reference-local`
  重写 `excludedDirectories`）——注意那也会让索引重新遍历这些目录。
- 只按工作区根一份规则文件生效，不支持子目录各自的 `.dshignore`。
- 规则变化后递归索引在后台重建，重建完成前由候选过滤兜底（用户看不到差别）。

## 常见问题：`@` 候选整个空了

先刷新页面（F5），再考虑重启 DSH：profile 反复重新组合（装插件、改 patch、切条目）
之后，Web 客户端的模块图可能是陈旧的。

可以确定**不是本插件的过滤**造成的：它只做减法——候选非空时，只有全部命中规则才会变空。
按这个顺序查：

1. 打开 `debug: true`，确认 `.dshignore` 被读到、看生效规则条数；
2. 逐条注释掉 `.dshignore` 里的规则，打 `@` 看候选是否恢复；
3. 只有"provider 本身返回空"（工作目录不对、目录不存在）才会一上来就没有候选。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 yangtzecoder

plugins.description: Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar, with their layout conflicts fixed. One package for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bot-codex-ui

**One install for the DS Bot team + Codex-style sidebar, with their layout conflicts fixed.**

This plugin bundles a modified copy of [ds-bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)
(Bot team, group chats, memory) and the [dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)
sidebar skin into a single DSH plugin. It fixes the visual conflicts that appear when
both are installed separately.

> Built on the shoulders of two giants: [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)
> and [MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui).

## What you get

- **DS Bot**: a team of long-lived Bots with group chats, memory, capabilities and usage tracking.
- **Codex-style sidebar**: workspace tree, search, turn navigation in a modern layout.
- **Fixed layout**: the composer, sidebar footer, account entry and conversation width
  no longer fight between the two plugins.

## What it fixes

| # | Problem (when both plugins are installed) | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Composer control row misaligned; buttons crowd | Restored the official column structure |
| 2 | Composer internal spacing wrong | Restored the official gap and padding |
| 3 | Bottom control band too tight (buttons nearly touch) | Restored a 10px rhythm |
| 4 | Sidebar footer stacks into two rows | Forced a single flex row |
| 5 | Footer height jumps between surfaces | Locked to 60px |
| 6 | Horizontal divider inconsistent between modes | Declared on the footer itself |
| 7 | Account entry wider than the mode tabs | Single 36px icon; name label hidden |
| 8 | One-way mode switch (only in Agent mode) | Two-tab switcher (Agent / DS Bot) |
| 9 | "Connect plugins" button with a standing red "!" badge | Moved into the account menu; badge retired |
| 10 | Conversation column wider than the classic Agent surface | Removed the local width pin |

## Install

**Install from GitHub** (this package vendors ds-bot via a `file:` dependency,
which means it cannot be published to npm — GitHub is the distribution channel):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Audrey-cn/dsh-bot-codex-ui
```

Or from a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-bot-codex-ui
```

**Do not install `ds-bot` or `@michengai/dsh-codex-ui` separately** — this plugin
bundles both. Installing them alongside will cause duplicate plugin entries.

## Self-check

Two seconds after mount, the plugin verifies its layout fixes in the rendered DOM:

1. Composer row wrapper exists and is a flex container (not `display:contents`).
2. Sidebar footer is a single flex row.
3. The red warning badge is hidden.
4. The mode tabs rendered.
5. The account entry is a single icon (no name label).

If any check fails, a dismissible red warning appears in the corner and a console
warning lists what went wrong. This prevents **silent failure** — the bugs returning
without any signal.

## Build

```sh
npm run build      # writes client.js
npm run check      # verifies client.js is up to date
```

## Repository layout

```
dsh-bot-codex-ui/
  package.json          dsh.bundle manifest + dependencies
  cordis.patch.yml      mounts codex-ui + ds-bot + our self-check
  index.js              host stub
  src/client/index.js   self-check client plugin
  ds-bot/               vendored ds-bot fork (with the 10 layout fixes)
  client.js             built self-check bundle
  README.md / LICENSE / NOTICE
```

## Upstream versions

| Upstream | Version | Relationship |
|---|---|---|
| ds-bot | 0.1.5 (vendored, modified) | `ds-bot/` directory |
| @michengai/dsh-codex-ui | 1.1.36 (unmodified) | npm dependency |

When ds-bot releases a new version, merge the changes into `ds-bot/` and rebuild.
The layout fixes are in `ds-bot/src/client/`; see the git log for the exact changes.


## Upstream update tracking

Both upstreams release very frequently (ds-bot roughly daily, dsh-codex-ui every
1–2 days), so this plugin can silently fall behind. Two mechanisms prevent that:

### Automated check (GitHub Actions)

A daily workflow runs [`scripts/check-upstream.mjs`](scripts/check-upstream.mjs)
and opens (or updates) a single tracking issue when either upstream has a newer
release. If the issue is no longer relevant, it is closed automatically.

### Local check

```sh
node scripts/check-upstream.mjs                # version check only
node scripts/check-upstream.mjs --test-patch   # also test the patch on new ds-bot
node scripts/check-upstream.mjs --json         # machine-readable
```

`--test-patch` clones the newest ds-bot and attempts to apply
[`ds-bot-local.patch`](ds-bot-local.patch). If the patch applies cleanly the merge
is mechanical; if not, a manual merge is needed (see the merge procedure in
`dsbot-local/SOP.md`).

### Baselines

[`base.json`](base.json) records the upstream release versions this plugin is
built from. The vendored `ds-bot/package.json` can disagree with the npm release
(upstream git tags sometimes carry a different version), so `base.json` is the
authoritative source for the version check.

## License

Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` for third-party attributions and
modification notices.

## Disclaimer

This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by,
or sponsored by DeepSeek, Fei2411, or MichengAI. "DeepSeek", "DS Bot" and "Codex"
are trademarks of their respective owners.

plugins.description: Workspace-level MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: one profile-scoped server registry, per-workspace selection, managed from a sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-mgr

**One MCP registry for the whole profile** — declare an MCP server once, choose it per workspace, and manage every server from a panel in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/releases)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> If this plugin saves you a round of hand-editing JSON, a ⭐ star helps the next person find it.

## Why this exists

MCP servers are declared per workspace, so the same server description gets copied into every workspace file that needs it — and drifts. This plugin splits the two questions that were tangled together:

| Question | Where it is answered now |
|---|---|
| *What servers exist?* | once, in a profile-scoped registry |
| *Which ones does this workspace use?* | a `use` list in that workspace's file |

Servers move between the two files without translation, both stay hand-editable, and a workspace that never adopts the plugin keeps working exactly as before: a missing `use` means its inline `mcpServers` mount as they always did.

## Screenshots

![The MCP Servers panel: the global server registry](docs/images/mcp-servers-panel.png)

*Global servers — add, edit, delete, enable or disable a server, with the profile-level `mcp-client` registrations shown as read-only rows.*

![The Workspaces tab: per-workspace server selection](docs/images/mcp-servers-workspaces.png)

*Workspaces — which global servers each workspace selects, plus its own local servers, dangling references and parse errors.*

## The two files

```
<profile>/.dsh/dshmm/mcp-servers.json     every server definition, shared
<workspace>/.dsh/dshmm/mcp.json           `use: [...]` selects from it,
                                          and may still declare inline servers
```

A selected global server mounts once for the whole profile; inline servers mount per workspace. Strict mode mounts only the active workspace's servers.

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row | sits directly under **Plugins** (`order: 1`) and opens the **MCP Servers** page in the centre column |
| Global servers tab | the registry: add / edit / delete / enable a server, plus the profile-level `mcp-client` registrations as read-only rows |
| Workspaces tab | per-workspace selection as checkboxes, each workspace's own local servers, dangling references, parse errors |
| JSON editing | paste a whole `mcpServers` object or one server's JSON; the host validates it and reports per-entry errors |
| Bulk import | import several servers at once, answering its own report |
| Tools | servers are registered through `mcp-client`; workspace tools use the `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` convention |
| Panel polish | optimistic selection toggles, a 60-second background refresh, tab and scroll position preserved across reloads, and a version chip carrying the installed plugin version |

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` installation (the plugin composes into a profile)
- `pnpm` 11.8.0 (`packageManager` in the root manifest pins it)

## Installation

Build both packages, pack them and hand them to the profile:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                        # typecheck → build → verify, both packages
sh tools/install-into-profile.sh desktop
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards; the sidebar entry appears directly under **Plugins**.

There are two packages, and both are Loader rows of their own:

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| `dsh-mcp-mgr` | the host half: the registry, the sync layer, and the `mcpMgr` Typert Remote contract |
| `dsh-mcp-mgr-ui` | the browser half: the sidebar row and the page it opens |

Installing the host alone leaves the sidebar row without the page it opens, so the two are built and installed together. The packages are not on npm: the profile installs them from this repository.

`dsh plugin` (a pnpm passthrough into the profile directory) is what the script uses; the Plugins page does the same thing. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh --profile desktop` itself refuses to compose it, while `dsh plugin` still works.

## Quick start

1. Open **MCP Servers** in the sidebar.
2. On **Global servers**, add a server — by form or by pasting JSON:

   ```json
   {
     "shared-http-server": {
       "type": "http",
       "url": "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
     }
   }
   ```

3. Switch to **Workspaces** and tick that server for the workspaces that should see it.
4. Restart, or let the panel's refresh confirm the new snapshot; the server's tools appear as `mcp__shared-http-server__*`.

## Configuration

Rules that apply to either file:

- a missing `type` is treated as Streamable HTTP; `${VAR}` expansion is supported;
- a stdio server without `cwd` uses the workspace root;
- `serverName` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$` and is globally unique — duplicates surface as conflicts;
- `"enabled": false` disables an entry without removing it; absent means enabled.

The profile registry is created on the first save from the panel. Neither file has to be created by hand.

## Remote surface

Fourteen methods on the `mcpMgr` namespace, declared once in `src/typert.descriptors.ts` and wrapped as the host manifest and the browser contribution, so the two faces cannot disagree about a wire name or a codec:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `version` | this package's installed version, for the title chip |
| `snapshot` | the whole management view |
| `setStrictMode` · `setActiveWorkspace` | gateway state, answering the refreshed snapshot |
| `apply` · `removeServer` · `setServerEnabled` | workspace-local servers |
| `saveGlobalServer` · `saveGlobalServerJson` · `removeGlobalServer` · `setGlobalServerEnabled` | the global registry |
| `setWorkspaceSelection` · `importLocalServer` | which servers a workspace selects |
| `importJson` | bulk import, answering its own report |

## Caveats

- **"Connected" means the tools are registered** (`mcp__<name>__*` present in the tool registry), not that the network is live. `mcp-client` exposes no live connection state, so a real disconnect cannot be detected without changing dsh itself. A connection that drops keeps its last tool generation and reconnects with backoff.
- **The refresh button re-reads the host's last snapshot**; it does not probe.
- The plugin polls no registry and offers no self-update: the panel shows its installed version, and updating means rebuilding and reinstalling it here.

## License and attribution

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The host and UI packages derive from `dsh-mcp-mgr` 0.2.0 by **yangfch3** (MIT); that copyright line is kept in the LICENSE file, and this repository is an independent, source-built rewrite rather than a vendored copy of the published bundle.

The panel registers into the same slots dsh's own pages use (`sidebar.panellist` and `main`), and follows the platform's `STYLES.md` contract for page geometry and the version chip.

> Stars are how small projects survive. If this one earned yours, tap ⭐ — it costs nothing and helps someone else find it.

plugins.description: The deterministic trust chain for DeepSeek Harness: eight plugins + dsh-bench-local — zero LLM in the trust path. Now expanding to OpenCode (oc-read-guard)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-trust-suite — the deterministic trust chain for DeepSeek Harness

One thesis, three plugins, zero LLM calls in the trust path:

> The dsh plugin ecosystem reviews agents with LLMs — answer reviewers,
> advisor loops, goal verifiers. Everything that *must not be an LLM* —
> the parts a probabilistic reviewer can be injected past — is what this
> family owns.

| Plugin | Guards | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-read-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard) | what the agent **reads** | Prompt-injection interception in the `tools/post-execute` waterfall: file reads, repo searches, and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context — quarantined, blocked, or passed. Engine: [repo-inject-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/repo-inject-guard) |
| [dsh-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate) | what the agent **writes** | Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope writes before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, a content-hashed JSONL ledger records every decision. The CI gate moved to the moment of the write. Engine: [agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate) |
| [dsh-attest-chain](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain) | what the agent **did** | Signed chain-of-custody: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record. Tamper with a line, break the chain; delete the tail, break the published head. Engine: [agent-attest](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-attest) |
| [dsh-mcp-test](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-mcp-test) | what the agent **can call** | Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: the full visible registry (first-party, plugin, MCP tools) is baselined and diffed — upgrades that silently change the model-visible surface fail loud. Methodology: [mcp-test](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/mcp-test) |
| [dsh-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor) | what the agent **leaves behind** | Deterministic cleanup plans for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts): scan → verdicts with evidence → review. The janitor is never an agent; v0.1 never deletes. Engine: [agent-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-janitor) |
| [dsh-egress-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate) | **where data may flow** | Destination allowlist for web fetches/searches, denied in `tools/pre-execute` before they run; shell fetch-verbs observed (enforcement opt-in). The other half of exfil defense: content scanning guards what enters, this guards where it leaves. |
| [dsh-prompt-drift](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift) | what the model is **told** | System-prompt surface drift gate: every section contributed by any plugin/preset is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of the prompt fails loud. |
| [dsh-freeze](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze) | what exactly is **running** | Hermetic composition lock: the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile hash, and patch layer are fingerprinted; booting a drifted composition warns — or fails under `strict` (the `--frozen` posture for CI). |

Read + write + do + call + leave-behind + egress + told + running: the eight
channels through which an agent session can go wrong, each gated by a
deterministic rule engine with its own upstream test suite, Windows+Linux
CI, and an honest kill-criteria section.

## Install the family

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-read-guard
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-pr-gate
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-attest-chain
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-mcp-test
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-janitor
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-egress-gate
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-prompt-drift
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-freeze
```

All ship prebuilt `lib/` — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization. Each ships its own config in `cordis.patch.yml`
and composes without interference (different pipeline stages).

## Second runtime: OpenCode

The family is expanding beyond dsh — [oc-read-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/oc-read-guard) ports the read-channel guard to [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) (tool.execute.after, live-verified quarantine in real sessions: the model reports the injection indicators and refuses to comply). One engine, every harness.

## Why a family, and against whom

The dsh security lane (checked 2026-10-12) is a long tail without a winner:
~15 injection-defense plugins, none above 85★, the strongest being a
model-callable scanner (the model can decline to call it) and one
three-point interceptor with literal pattern lists. Nothing on the write
side, nothing on custody. The family's edge is not being first — it is that
every rule engine here is vendored from a battle-tested upstream repository
with its own CI, competitive analysis, and kill criteria, instead of being a
weekend pattern list. Few plugins, deep engines, upstream ownership — the
deliberate opposite of the 90-plugin land-grab strategy visible in the
ecosystem today.

## Roadmap (next in the family)

- **dsh-bench** has shipped as its own repo —
  [zhengqiuyang/dsh-bench](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-bench-local): bench
  your dsh configuration against your own tasks via `dsh headless`
  (live-verified). Its mining pillar (tasks from git history, graded by your
  own tests) ports agentbench-local next.
- **skills lockfile** — hermetic pinning for skills/plugins à la
  [vendor-skills](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/vendor-skills); today's
  supply-chain plugins all static-scan, none reproducibly pin.
- **mcp-test probe pillar** — behavioral + injection probes against running
  MCP servers (the headline feature of upstream mcp-test) on top of
  dsh-mcp-test's drift gate.

## Kill criteria

Per-plugin kill criteria live in each README. Family-level: if dsh ships a
first-party deterministic trust layer covering read/write/custody, the family
freezes and this README records the postmortem. The engines live on in their
upstream repositories regardless.

# dsh-model-usage

适用于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**供应商模型账户用量查询插件**。

它在会话页面头部放一个「用量」入口，点开即可看到**当前对话所用模型**对应供应商账户的用量
——余额、套餐窗口、已用额度、信用余额；也可以手动切到任意可路由的模型，去查别的供应商的额度，
不必再逐个打开各家控制台。

- 插件包本体：[`model-usage/`](model-usage/)（包名 `dsh-model-usage`）
- 功能细节（原理、凭据解析、各家用量接口、刷新策略、面板内容、安装步骤）：
  [model-usage/README.md](model-usage/README.md)
- 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE)

## 仓库结构

| 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| [`model-usage/`](model-usage/) | 插件包本体：node 半负责用量查询与 loopback Web 路由，浏览器半负责会话头部入口与弹窗面板 |
| [`model-usage/README.md`](model-usage/README.md) | 插件层功能说明，是使用与二次开发的主要文档 |
| [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) | MIT License |

## 快速开始

安装与挂载步骤见[插件说明](model-usage/README.md#安装)，概括为三步：

1. 把 `model-usage/` 作为插件包装进 DSH profile（`dsh plugin add <插件目录绝对路径>`，
   或直接复制 / 建 junction 到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-model-usage`）；
2. 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 里挂载入口 `dsh-model-usage`；
3. 重启 `dsh web`（host 半生效），浏览器硬刷新（浏览器半生效）。

## 参与贡献

**这个项目友善地欢迎开源合作，也欢迎任何人提交 PR。**
无论是新增一家供应商的用量适配器、修掉一个边界情况、改进文案与文档，还是指出我们写错的字段名，
都同样有价值；哪怕只是把某家接口的真实返回贴给我们做校准，也是实打实的帮助。

- **新供应商适配**：在 `model-usage/lib/index.js` 里认领一个 query kind（`kindOf()` 按 host / provider 判定）、
  写一个归一化函数（`{ rows }` / `{ windows, models }`），客户端会自动用通用卡片渲染；
  已支持的路由与接口形态见[用量接口](model-usage/README.md#用量接口)。
- **未文档化的接口**：如果某家用量接口没有公开文档，欢迎在 PR 描述里附上脱敏后的真实返回，
  我们会据此收敛字段名，而不是靠猜。
- **提交方式**：fork 本仓库 → 建一个语义清晰的分支 → 提交 PR，并在描述里写清「解决什么、怎么验证、影响哪些路由」。
  状态类改动请附上截图或最小复现步骤。
- **协作方式**：我们会对每个 PR 认真 review、尽量及时回复；分歧时优先讨论方案而不是互相消耗。
  提交即表示同意你的贡献以本仓库的 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)发布。
- 还不确定怎么改也没关系，先开 issue 描述你看到的场景与期望行为，我们一起来定方案。

## 许可证与生态

本项目以 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布。

- 上游 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 同样以 **MIT** 许可发布，
  与本仓库一致，因此代码可以在两个方向自由复用；若将来某个适配器被官方收录，也不存在许可障碍。
- 本项目是**独立的社区插件**，与深度求索公司无隶属、合作或背书关系；
  "DeepSeek Harness" 是深度求索公司的注册商标，本仓库仅在描述性文字中说明兼容关系。
  命名遵循官方[品牌素材使用规范](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/BRAND_GUIDELINES.zh.md)，
  使用 `DSH` 缩写而非完整商标。
- 如果你是插件作者，可以在自己的仓库上添加 `dsh-plugin` 话题，方便社区检索（官方推荐做法）。
