# agent-stash

[![CI](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Sync init prompts](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Alice39s/agent-stash)](LICENSE)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/Alice39s/agent-stash)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/commits/main)
[![pi package](https://img.shields.io/badge/pi-package-111111)](https://pi.dev)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D24-339933?logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org)
[![pnpm](https://img.shields.io/badge/pnpm-11-f69220?logo=pnpm&logoColor=white)](https://pnpm.io)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-strict-3178c6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](tsconfig.json)

自用的 Agent Skills、[pi](https://pi.dev) 扩展与 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)插件合集。

## 目录

| 路径                   | 内容                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/`                 | pi 与 DSH 共用的实现                                                              |
| `pi/extensions/`       | pi 扩展，由 `package.json` 的 `pi.extensions` 声明                                |
| `dsh/`                 | DSH 插件源码、`cordis.patch.yml`、本地化文案与图标                                |
| `dist/`                | DSH 插件的构建产物，由 `pnpm build` 生成，随仓库提交                              |
| `vendor/init-prompts/` | 从上游仓库同步的 `/init` prompt、许可证与 `manifest.json`，由脚本生成，不手动修改 |
| `scripts/`             | 同步脚本                                                                          |

## 安装

### pi

```bash
pi install git:github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash
```

只在当前会话试用：

```bash
pi -e git:github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash
```

### DSH

DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：在「插件」页点「添加插件」，填入 `github:Alice39s/agent-stash` 后安装。

命令行：把仓库作为 bundle 装进某个 profile，例如 Web 界面使用的 `web`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alice39s/agent-stash
```

`dist/` 已随仓库提交，安装时不需要构建。DSH 的斜杠命令目前只在 Web 界面与桌面版里可用。

## `/init`

让 agent 分析当前项目并写出 `AGENTS.md`，prompt 取自其他 coding agent 的开源实现。pi 与 DSH 的用法相同。

```text
/init                         使用默认预设
/init kimi-code               使用 kimi-code 预设
/init opencode 重点写测试流程    使用 opencode 预设并附加额外指令
/init 用中文写                 第一个词不是预设名时，整段文字作为默认预设的额外指令
```

pi：

- 输入 `/init ` 后，补全菜单列出每个预设及其上游来源，默认预设标出 `(default)`。
- 选中预设后，菜单提示可以继续输入 `[extra prompt]`。

DSH：

- 命令菜单列出全部预设，默认预设标出 `(default)`。
- 输入框提示可用的预设名，例如 `[codex|kimi-code|opencode] [extra prompt]`。
- 预设列表在 DSH 加载插件时生成，修改配置后要重启 DSH 才会更新。

### 内置预设

| 预设            | 上游                                                            | 文件                                                              | 许可证     |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `codex`（默认） | [openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)                 | `codex-rs/tui/assets/prompt_for_init_command.md`                  | Apache-2.0 |
| `kimi-code`     | [MoonshotAI/kimi-code](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code) | `packages/agent-core-v2/src/features/sessionInit/profile/init.md` | MIT        |
| `opencode`      | [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode)     | `packages/core/src/plugin/command/initialize.txt`                 | MIT        |

每个预设对应的上游 commit 记录在 `vendor/init-prompts/manifest.json`。

### 额外指令与占位符

模板里的占位符在发送前替换：

- `${path}`：当前项目目录。DSH 里取会话的当前工作目录。
- `$ARGUMENTS`：额外指令。

模板没有 `$ARGUMENTS` 时，额外指令追加到 prompt 末尾的 `## Additional instructions from the user` 小节。

### 配置

配置文件按以下顺序读取，后读的覆盖先读的。

pi：

1. `~/.pi/agent/agent-stash/init.json`（设置了 `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` 时为 `$PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/agent-stash/init.json`）
2. `<项目>/.pi/agent-stash/init.json`，仅在项目受信任时读取

DSH：

1. `$DSH_HOME/agent-stash/init.json`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/agent-stash/init.json`）

```json
{
  "defaultPreset": "team",
  "presets": {
    "team": {
      "file": "./team-init.md",
      "description": "团队的 AGENTS.md 模板"
    }
  }
}
```

- `defaultPreset`：不写预设名时使用的预设，默认为 `codex`。
- `presets`：自定义预设。`file` 是相对配置文件所在目录的路径，同名预设覆盖内置预设。`description` 显示在补全菜单里，不写时显示文件路径。

配置格式错误或默认预设不存在时，`/init` 直接报错。

## 上游同步

`.github/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml` 每天运行一次，也可以手动触发。它拉取各上游默认分支最新 commit 中的 prompt 与根目录的 LICENSE、NOTICE 文件，运行检查后向 `chore/sync-init-prompts` 分支开 PR。

仓库需要在 Settings → Actions → General 中开启「Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests」，workflow 才能创建 PR。

本地同步：

```bash
GITHUB_TOKEN=<token> pnpm sync:init-prompts
```

上游列表在 `scripts/sync-init-prompts.ts` 的 `SOURCES` 中维护。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check    # oxfmt --check、oxlint 类型检查与 vitest
pnpm build    # 用 tsdown 生成 dist/dsh/init.js
pnpm format
```

改动 `src/` 或 `dsh/` 后要运行 `pnpm build` 并提交 `dist/`。CI 会重新构建，`dist/` 与源码不一致时失败。

## 许可证

本仓库使用 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。`vendor/init-prompts/` 下的文件沿用各自上游的许可证，许可证原文与上游 prompt 放在同一目录。

plugins.description: Use your Zed AI subscription (Pro / Student) from DeepSeek Harness: registers the zed-agent route with Claude + GPT models, an editable Models-page card and a model chooser.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zed-provider

Run your **Zed AI subscription** (Zed Pro / Student — the monthly prompt credits)
inside DeepSeek Harness. The bundle registers one LLM provider route,
`zed-agent`, whose turns are minted and streamed through Zed Cloud
(`https://cloud.zed.dev`) exactly as the Zed editor does it.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zed-provider
```

## Link your Zed account

Type `/zed-login` in the Harness composer. The command opens Zed's native-app
sign-in page, waits for the loopback callback, and stores the resulting grant in
the Harness credential store (`llm-zed/zed-agent`). Later requests reuse it, and
the short-lived gateway token is minted automatically and refreshed on demand.

Credentials are resolved in this order, so any one of them is enough:

1. `config.credentials` — a literal `"<userId> <accessToken>"` (or JSON) value.
2. `config.apiKeyEnv` (default `ZED_CREDENTIALS`) — resolved through the
   credential seam. The Models settings page shows this as the Zed card's key
   field, so a credential pasted there works without `/zed-login`.
3. The `llm-zed/zed-agent` grant record written by `/zed-login`.
4. The Zed editor's own local keyring entry, on macOS (`zed.dev`) and Linux
   (`secret-tool`), imported once into the grant record — sign in inside Zed and
   this plugin picks it up by itself.

`apiKeyEnv` is spelled that way because the Models page reads exactly that field
name; its value is a credential *reference*, and what it holds is the
`"<userId> <accessToken>"` pair Zed issues.

## Settings UI

Settings → **Models** → the **Zed** card carries this bundle's own editor
(`lib/client.js`, a client-module half registered on the page's
`settings.models.provider-card` seat for the `llm-zed` namespace):

- credential status, from the card's credential join plus a live
  `credentials/describe`;
- a credential field that stores `"<userId> <accessToken>"` under the reference
  `apiKeyEnv` names (read live from the settings document, default
  `ZED_CREDENTIALS`), with **Remove** to unset it;
- a refusal instead of a silent no-op when that reference is supplied by a
  read-only source such as an environment variable.

It also carries the **model chooser**: the Host registers
`llm.registerModelDiscovery` for this namespace, the page reads it through
`llm/discoverModels`, and the tick boxes write `visibleModels` through
`settings/mutate`. That field is volatile, so a tick changes the picker on the
next catalog read without a reload; an empty or complete selection unsets it,
meaning "offer every model this plugin can run".

`baseUrl` stays a composition-only field in `cordis.patch.yml`.

The client fiber hard-injects only `slots`, `locale` and `remote`, and picks the
credential remote up through `ctx.inject(['remote.credentials'], …)`. That is
deliberate: the web boot asserts that every client entry activated, so a root
client plugin that waits on a service the settings UI keeps private (such as
`settingsScope`) takes the whole GUI boot down with
`<package>: pending (waiting for service: …)`.

## Models

`listModels` reads `GET /models` with your credential and advertises the models
Zed reports for the backends this plugin implements — **Claude** (Anthropic
Messages) and **GPT** (OpenAI Responses). Zed's Gemini and Grok entries are
filtered out rather than offered broken; selecting one anyway fails fast with
`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`.

Each model carries Zed's own context window, output cap, and — when
`supports_thinking` — the effort levels `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`, mapped
onto Anthropic extended thinking budgets.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `ZED_CREDENTIALS` | Credential reference holding `"<userId> <accessToken>"`. |
| `credentials` | absent | Literal credential value; highest priority, composition-time. |
| `baseUrl` | `https://cloud.zed.dev` | Zed Cloud endpoint. |
| `visibleModels` | all supported | Narrow the catalog to these model ids. |

## Quota

Zed owns the accounting: no plan or no credits left answers HTTP 402, which
surfaces as a `QUOTA` failure naming https://zed.dev/account. The plugin does
not invent percentages or limits.

## Development

`pnpm install` (which runs the `prepare` hook), then `pnpm check` —
typecheck, build, tests. Sources are TypeScript under `src/`; `lib/` is build
output and is git-ignored, because the `prepare`/`prepack` hooks rebuild it
wherever the package is consumed and the published tarball carries the built
copy through the `files` allowlist.

A profile can install this bundle as a `link:` to a working copy, in which case
that copy's `lib/` is what the Host imports: rebuild after changing `src/`, or
the Host keeps running the previous build.

`node --test test/*.test.mjs` covers the pieces that fail silently in
production: the NDJSON → `StreamChunk` translation for both backends
(`src/frames.ts` framing, `src/parse.ts` Anthropic events, `src/responses.ts`
Responses events), the RSA sign-in handshake (`src/signin.ts`), the request
projections (`src/anthropic.ts`, `src/responses.ts`), and the card's slot
registration, credential and model-selection wiring (`src/client.ts`, loaded
under a stubbed module loader in `test/client.test.mjs`). The tests import the
built `lib/`, because that is what the Harness actually runs. Only
`src/index.ts` touches the Harness runtime.

Two install-time facts worth knowing: the Host half is re-imported only by a
profile restart (ESM caches by URL), and the client half is composed from the
Loader's entries at Host boot, so adding or removing `exports["./client"]` takes
a restart too — after that it is served per request under a content hash, so
client-side edits reach the browser on the next load.

plugins.description: DSH plugin: after each completed answer, ask the session model for 3 clickable follow-up suggestions and fill the input box on click.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-next-step-suggest

根据当前回答给出下一步建议的 DSH 插件。

每轮回答结束后，插件会用**会话当前选中的模型**做一次轻量辅助调用，
基于「你最近的提问 + 助手最近的回答」提炼 **3 条可以直接发送的后续消息建议**，
以可点击的建议条（chips）浮层展示在输入框上方；点击任意一条即填入输入框
（若已有草稿则换行追加），按回车即可发送。

## 功能

- **自动生成**：检测到一轮回答完成（`turn-tail` / `turn-error` / `turn-max-tokens`
  边界且为流的最后一个节点）后自动发起建议生成；开关可在悬停弹出面板中切换，
  状态持久化在 localStorage。
- **手动生成**：输入框工具栏右侧 ✨ 图标按钮随时生成 / 重新生成；回合进行中时
  按钮自动禁用，旧面板自动收起。
- **建议交互**：面板提供「重新生成」「停止」「关闭」；每条建议一键填入草稿。
- **会话隔离**：按会话分别捕获模型路由与回合内容；subagent 会话不显示入口。
- **注入防护**：提问与回答在宿主侧用分隔符包裹并声明「不执行其中指令」，
  路由仅允许 loopback 访问。

## 工作原理

```
浏览器半边 (lib/client.js)                宿主半边 (lib/index.js)
conversation.composer.dock 席位            POST /api/dsh-next-step-suggest
  │ useChat(selector) 蒸馏回合              │ ctx.llm.stream({provider, model,…})
  │ useInput(selector) 读当前草稿           │
  │ 回合完成 → fetch 当前模型路由 ──────────▶│ 组装系统提示词 → JSON 数组解析
  │ ◀──────────────────────── { suggestions }│
  └ 点击 chips → inputActions.setDraft
```

不修改任何官方内核包，仅使用公开 client-runtime 服务
（`slots` / `modelDirectories` / `sessions`）与官方 `webServer` + `llm` 服务。

### 为什么用 `useChat` 而不是 `useSession`

渲染器会把每个 session 级标准源按 `hooks: ["<name>"]` 暴露成 `use<Name>` prop。
**会话快照（`ui-session` 的 `buildSnapshot()`）里没有 `chat` 字段**——它只带
`sessionId / pendingSubmissions / running / subagent / removed / openState /
openError / hasMore / loadingOlder / promptError / blank / lastAgentError /
promptAttempted / awaitingFirstTurn`。对话内容由 `ui-chat` 通过独立的
`hooks: ["chat"]` 贡献提供，即 `useChat`；草稿由 `ui-conversation` 的
`conversation.input` 贡献提供，即 `useInput`。

因此 `useSession((s) => s.chat)` 恒为 `undefined`，selector 会静默返回空串，
表现为「按钮在、面板不弹、点了提示当前会话还没有已完成的回答」。组件现在优先
取 `useChat`，仅在拿不到时回退 `useSession`（selector 两种快照形态都兼容）。
`/diag` 里的 `hook-shape` 事件会记录实际选中的源，便于以后排查。

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:anye-99/dsh-next-step-suggest
```

安装后重启 DSH。建议钉住提交以保证可复现：
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:anye-99/dsh-next-step-suggest#<commit>`。

### 本地开发安装（profile 本地插件）

1. 将本目录复制到 `<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/local-plugins/dsh-next-step-suggest/`
2. 在 `<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 中加入：
   ```json
   "dsh-next-step-suggest": "link:./local-plugins/dsh-next-step-suggest"
   ```
   并在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾加入 `"dsh-next-step-suggest"`
3. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`
4. 重启 DSH

## 卸载

从 `package.json` 移除上述两处条目，`pnpm install` 后重启即可；
删除 localStorage 键 `dsh-next-step-suggest:auto` 可重置开关。

## 已知限制

- 建议生成使用会话当前模型（与主对话同源，路由失败时面板会显示错误并可重试）。
- 回答过长时宿主端截断为头 2KB + 尾 4KB，超长代码输出的细节可能被略去。
- 页面刚加载时已存在的最后一个完成回合不会自动弹出建议，点 ✨ 手动生成即可
  （避免切换会话时刷屏）。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: 东南大学校园主题插件：校园配色、九龙湖与四牌楼风景、可选叮东，适配 DSH Web。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Campus · SEU [![CI](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Code license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH 0.2.0-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 把东南大学的校园绿、校训、建筑与叮东带进 DSH Web。 一个独立维护的单校校园主题插件，支持九龙湖与四牌楼两种风景，跟随宿主浅色、深色和系统外观。与东南大学及 DeepSeek 官方无隶属或背书关系。 ![浅色主题，开启可选叮东](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/main/docs/screenshots/v0.3/light-mascot.jpg) 截图开启了可选叮东，安装后的默认值为关闭。截图中的摄影与角色素材说明见 [素材来源](ATTRIBUTION.md)。 ## 功能 - **校园氛围**：校园绿与金色点缀、完整校徽、「止于至善」校训、1902 侧栏铭牌，连同宿主菜单一起适配。 - **两种校区风景**：九龙湖李文正图书馆、四牌楼大礼堂；缩略图下拉列表支持键盘导航。 - **可选叮东**：内置透明背景的挥手重建形象，独立开关；支持替换为自己的本地图片，随时恢复内置形象。 - **按需显示**：主题、欢迎卡、校训和叮东均可开关；关闭主题恢复宿主外观。 - **集中设置**：仅使用「设置 → 校园主题(SEU)」入口，位于内置设置项下方。素材来源和署名统一收纳在设置中。 - **响应式布局**：适配浅色、深色、窄窗口、矮窗口及主栏宽度变化，保留宿主输入框与会话交互。
查看深色、窄窗口和设置效果 ![深色主题](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/main/docs/screenshots/v0.3/dark-mascot.jpg) ![主题设置](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/main/docs/screenshots/v0.3/settings-mascot.jpg)
## 安装 兼容 **DSH Web `0.2.0-rc.2`**。CLI/TUI 不适用。先确认 `dsh --version`，并将下面的 `YOUR_PROFILE` 替换为你正在使用的 Web profile 名称。 推荐从 [Releases](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/releases) 安装预构建包，无需在用户机器编译： ```sh dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/releases/download/v0.3.0/dsh-campus-seu-0.3.0.tgz --ignore-scripts ``` 安装后重新启动该 profile 的 DSH Web 并刷新浏览器，在「设置 → 校园主题(SEU)」中调整。校园主题默认启用，叮东默认关闭。 也可下载 Release 的 `.tgz` 后安装本地文件： ```sh dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add ./dsh-campus-seu-0.3.0.tgz --ignore-scripts ``` 卸载后同样重新启动 DSH Web： ```sh dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE remove dsh-campus-seu ``` ## 使用与数据 所有设置即时生效。偏好仅保存在当前浏览器的 `dsh-campus-seu.preferences.v1` 中，并在同源标签页间同步；不改写 DSH 自身的外观偏好，不修改对话数据。 自选叮东图片支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP，最大 512 KiB，在当前浏览器中保存，不上传。「恢复内置形象」仅清除自选图片，保留叮东显示开关；「恢复主题默认设置」会清除本插件的偏好，恢复主题启用、九龙湖欢迎卡和校训，关闭叮东。 ## 本地开发 需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` 和 pnpm `10.33.2`。依赖与宿主版本由锁文件固定。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu.git cd dsh-campus-seu pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts pnpm run check pnpm run dev ``` `dev` 在本目录 `.runtime/dsh-home` 中创建隔离的 Web profile，默认仅监听 `127.0.0.1:39395`。打开终端输出的本地认证地址即可预览。它不复制现有账号、模型密钥或用户 DSH 配置。 仓库提交预构建的 `lib/client.js`，修改源码后请运行 `pnpm run check` 并同步提交构建产物。CI 会检查构建、自动测试、已提交产物一致性和打包。 生成分发包： ```sh pnpm run check pnpm pack --pack-destination .runtime/dist ``` 分发包只包含插件入口、客户端产物、素材、补丁和必要说明，不含开发实例、认证配置、缓存、截图或用户自选图片。保留 `private: true` 以防意外发布 npm；不影响 GitHub 与 tarball 安装。 ## 兼容性与验证 本版本基于 DSH Web `0.2.0-rc.2` 的主题 API 与插槽。欢迎卡扩展了 `conversation.hero.brand.mark` 品牌插槽的布局；升级宿主后需重新检查外观。其他插件同时占用该插槽或覆盖相同颜色时，显示受优先级与覆盖顺序影响。 当前自动测试涵盖设置持久化、输入校验、素材路由边界及外观清理生命周期。真实 DSH 中的浅色、深色、窄窗口和设置交互记录见 [界面验证记录](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)。这些检查不包含模型回答质量或所有第三方插件组合。 ## 开源与素材 **插件代码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。图片和品牌素材使用各自的许可或权利说明。** 两张建筑照片分别采用 CC BY-SA 4.0、CC BY-SA 3.0；校徽及叮东角色不因代码开源获得额外授权。内置叮东是 AI 重建形象，不是官方标准图。 完整范围见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)、[素材来源与署名](ATTRIBUTION.md) 和 [叮东生成记录](docs/dingdong-generation.md)。界面截图中出现的素材同样适用这些说明。 仓库使用 `dsh` 和官方约定的 `dsh-plugin` topics。打包遵循 [DSH 插件发布文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish)，发现规则见 [DSH README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#community-and-support)。

plugins.description: Read-only CSV/XLSX change review for DeepSeek Harness: align business keys, inspect values and formulas, and export review comments.
plugins.readme_text:
# SheetDiff

Review spreadsheet changes before trusting them.

SheetDiff compares two CSV or XLSX files by a business key, not by row position. It produces a local HTML report where you can inspect values, types, formulas and stored formula results, then leave comments for a follow-up with your agent.

It is an independent DeepSeek Harness plugin. It also has a small CLI. It does not edit workbooks, calculate formulas, upload data, or require an API key.

![Local review report showing a formula change and an exported comment](docs/review-demo.jpg)

## Try it locally

Requires Node.js 22.19 or newer. Clone the repository and try the synthetic demo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff.git
cd dsh-sheet-diff
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run demo
```

The demo writes two **synthetic** workbooks and a `report.html` to a new directory under `artifacts/`. Open the printed report path in a browser. The expected result is three added rows and four changed cells: two amounts, one formula with a changed stored result, and one number changed to text. Reordering rows and columns adds no changes.

For your own files:

```sh
node src/cli.js before.xlsx after.xlsx --key OrderID --out review-001
node src/cli.js examples/before.csv examples/after.csv --key OrderID --out review-csv
```

`--out` must name a new directory. Use repeated `--key` flags for a composite key. `--sheet Orders` selects one sheet; `--header-row 3` changes the header row. Otherwise, all sheets use row 1 as their header and must have the chosen key columns. CSV has one logical sheet named `CSV`.

Compare CSV with CSV, or XLSX with XLSX. Mixed-format comparisons are rejected in this release.

## Use with DeepSeek Harness

Install the versioned release bundle into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-sheet-diff-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart that profile after installation. The package ships JavaScript and a `dsh.bundle` patch; there is no plugin build step or install script. You can also build the bundle from source with `npm pack` and install its local absolute path. Releases are distributed through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases); this project is not published to npm.

Tested against Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, with explicit preview-version peer ranges. Both were installed into fresh profiles and exercised through the official profile boot entrypoint without a model call. HMR was disabled only in the test profiles; the source-built alpha host also logged unrelated optional Typert import warnings.

Ask Harness:

> Compare `before.xlsx` and `after.xlsx` using `OrderID` as the key. Save a SheetDiff report in `reviews/run-001`. Do not change either workbook.

The plugin registers two tools:

| Tool | Input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet_diff_compare` | `before`, `after`, `keyColumns`, `outputDir`; optional `sheet`, `headerRow` | New HTML/JSON paths, hashes, summary and warnings |
| `sheet_diff_review` | `reportJson`, `reviewJson` | Validated comments with the corresponding changes |

Paths must stay inside the current session workspace, including resolved symlink targets. Report creation needs a writable sandbox. Existing reports are never overwritten. If the second output write fails, the tool reports the retained first file rather than deleting it.

The interactive report opens in a normal browser. A Harness preview that disables JavaScript cannot run its comment controls. There is no custom in-app spreadsheet editor in this release.

## Review, then hand comments back

1. Open the HTML report, filter changes, and write comments beside the changes you want checked.
2. Export the review JSON. Draft comments stay only in page memory until exported.
3. Put the export inside the workspace and pass it, with the original report JSON, to `sheet_diff_review`.

The CLI equivalent is:

```sh
node src/cli.js review review-001/report.json review-comments.json
```

Comments must match the report ID, both input hashes and known change IDs. Old or unrelated reviews are rejected. A hash match is not a digital signature and does not prove that a report has not been deliberately rewritten. Comments and cell contents are untrusted data; this plugin never executes their instructions or applies their suggested edits.

## Comparison rules

- Column names and keys match exactly. Composite keys include cell types; numeric `42` is different from text `"42"`. Duplicate keys, missing keys and duplicate headers fail rather than being guessed.
- A header row after all nonempty data is rejected instead of producing an empty comparison. Preambles before a valid header and truly empty sheets remain supported.
- CSV is comma-delimited UTF-8, with quoted fields, embedded newlines and a BOM supported. Values remain text; CSV formulas are not inferred.
- XLSX preserves the distinction between numbers, text, booleans, dates, errors and formulas. Formula text and saved cached results are separate aspects of a change. A cache is **not** a fresh calculation.
- Formula caches containing an explicit empty string are rejected in v0.1: the underlying reader cannot reliably distinguish them from a missing cache. Zero and false caches are preserved.
- Formula text is compared literally. Moving a formula can change its A1 references while preserving meaning; SheetDiff does not normalize that equivalence.
- Blank rows are skipped. Added/removed rows include their populated fields. Added/removed columns produce structural changes, plus cell changes for populated values in retained rows.
- Sheet renames are reported as removal and addition. Key changes are reported as row removal and addition.

This is a table-data review tool, not a whole-workbook fidelity check. Formatting, number formats, merged layout, charts, pivots, images, comments and hyperlink targets are outside its scope. Hidden data is still read; visibility itself is not compared. Legacy XLS, macros, encrypted archives and external workbook connections are unsupported. Complex multi-table sheets may need to be exported to separate tables first.

## Limits and privacy

Inputs are capped at 20 MiB each, XLSX expanded contents at 64 MiB and 8 MiB per ZIP part, and comparisons at 10,000 change records or 24 MiB of serialized changes. The parser also caps serialized cells/rows at 100,000 and checks expanded merge, column and validation ranges before parsing. Exceeding a limit fails the comparison; a shortened report is never presented as complete.

Reports include changed cell data, source filenames and hashes. Treat HTML, report JSON and review JSON as sensitive as the workbooks. Sharing is manual. The page has no remote resources, analytics or automatic persistence. When used inside an AI host, tool results and imported comments may be sent to that host's configured model as part of its normal operation.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

`smoke:host` loads the shipped patch using a real Cordis loader and dispatches both tools through the real tool runtime, filesystem provider and sandbox policy. It also checks source bytes, overwrite rejection and plugin disposal. It uses a fresh temporary workspace; it does not change an existing Harness profile. The test is separate from a full CLI installation and does not use a live model.

## 中文简介

AI 改完表格后，先看清楚改了什么，再决定是否采用。SheetDiff 按订单号、账户号等业务主键对齐记录，避免把行列重排当成大量修改；数值、类型、公式和保存的计算结果分开显示。你可以在本地报告中逐条评论，导出后交回 Harness 继续处理。

首版只读 CSV/XLSX，不上传表格、不重算公式、不自动改文件。它不是表格编辑器，也不承诺检测格式、图表或所有 Excel 功能的变化。

MIT licensed. Bug reports are most useful with a small anonymized example and the expected comparison result. Please do not post confidential workbooks.

plugins.description: dsh Web GUI 插件：给右侧栏标签的右键菜单补上固定标签、关闭其他/左侧/右侧/所有标签。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-tab-actions

给 dsh Web GUI 右侧栏的标签右键菜单补上该有的那几个操作。装之前菜单里只有一条「关闭」，装之后同一个菜单变成：

```
关闭              ← 套件自带的
────────────────
📌 固定
关闭其他
关闭右侧
关闭左侧
关闭全部          ← 危险色
```

只跟 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 及之后的版本对齐，只在浏览器半边运行，host 半边是空的。

## 行为

| 菜单项 | 关掉什么 |
|---|---|
| 固定 / 取消固定 | 切换当前标签的固定状态，按会话持久化 |
| 关闭其他 | 同一分栏里除自己以外的全部标签 |
| 关闭右侧 | 同一分栏里排在自己右边的全部标签 |
| 关闭左侧 | 同一分栏里排在自己左边的全部标签 |
| 关闭全部 | 同一分栏的全部标签，包括自己 |

文案刻意压到两到四字，跟 dsh 自己那套 dock 词汇（`关闭`／`分栏`／`全屏`）同一种语感——菜单里只有套件那条「关闭」是两字、其余都四字以上，读起来会跳。

五条规则，一句话说完：

1. **固定标签不被任何批量关闭动到**，四个关闭项都会跳过它。
2. **目标为空的项不出现**。右键第一个标签时没有「关闭左侧」，整个分栏只剩一个标签时四个关闭项全不出现。
3. **顺序就是屏幕上看到的顺序**。dsh 按分栏自己的标签数组画 chip，所以 DOM 顺序就是布局顺序。
4. **唯一停靠的引导页不算可关闭**，那种分栏上只剩下「固定」一项，和 dsh 自己藏掉关闭按钮的规则一致。
5. **固定状态按会话存**，键是 `dsh.sidebar-tab-actions.pins.v1.<sessionId>`，刷新页面和重启应用都还在。

固定的 chip 会在标题左边出一枚图钉。

## 已知限制

- **固定拦不住单点关闭。** chip 上的 × 和套件自带的「关闭」由 dsh 自己决定，插件没有席位去否决。所以固定的语义是「不被批量关掉」，跟 VS Code、Chrome 的固定标签可以单独关闭是一致的。
- **批量关闭会产生多条撤销记录。** dsh 的 `ISidebarRight` 只有单个 `close(tabId)`，关 N 个标签就是 N 步撤销，和手动逐个关闭一样。
- **关掉分栏最后一个标签会让整列收起**，这是 dsh 自身规则，「关闭全部」因此可能把右栏收起来。固定一个标签就能避免。
- **固定按标签 id 记，不按内容记。** 关掉再重新打开同一个文件，固定会丢——dsh 的 chip 上只有标签 id 可读，而 VS Code 的 pin 也是绑定在 editor 实例上的。
- **图钉是 DOM 装饰。** 插件往 chip 上写一个自己拥有的 `data-dsh-tab-pinned` 属性并注入一张样式表，随插件一起回收。不想要就配 `badge: false`。

## 安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zhaoruizhe81/dsh-sidebar-tab-actions.git
cd dsh-sidebar-tab-actions

# 先退出 DeepSeek Harness，profile 的 package.json 有文件锁
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add link:"$PWD"
```

装完重新打开 App。`dsh` 会把包名写进 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，包里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 再作为 bundle 层把插件行插进 roster——profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 不用动。

两个可能绊到你的地方：

- **`cli/bin/dsh` 没有可执行位**，直接跑会 `Permission denied`，用 `sh "<那个路径>"` 调。
- **`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` 会让退出码非零**，于是 `dsh` 跳过自动写 `dsh.profile.bundles` 那一步。依赖和软链已经装好了，手动把 `"dsh-sidebar-tab-actions"` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾即可。（那几条被忽略的构建脚本来自 profile 里既有的 `@google/genai`、`protobufjs`，跟本插件无关。）

卸载：

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-sidebar-tab-actions
```

或者在「设置 → 插件」里直接停用这个 bundle。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里用同一个 id 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: sidebar-tab-actions
  name: dsh-sidebar-tab-actions
  config:
    badge: false        # 关掉固定标签的 chip 图钉
```

## 改代码

`lib/client.js` 就是产物本身，没有构建步骤——它是按 dsh 客户端模块系统要求的闭包工厂形状手写的，只 require 模块表里的基线条目（React、`dsh-client-store`、`dsh-client-ui-primitives`）。

**保存即生效：不用刷新，不用重启，也不用在设置里停用再启用。**

host 侧的 `dsh-client-hmr` 按固定间隔 stat 轮询每个 bundle 的 `client.js`（刻意用轮询——网络挂载不产生 inotify 事件），mtime / ctime / size 一变就换掉该 row 的 revision，通过 `/plugins/events` 的 SSE 推给页面，页面随即重新 import 这一行；插件的 effect 先拆再装，新文案直接上屏。实测从写盘到页面拿到新 revision 在秒级。

改动包元数据（`package.json` 的 `dsh.client`、`cordis.patch.yml`）或 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 也算数：profile HMR 监视 profile 的 `package.json` 与两层 `cordis.patch.yml`，一有变化就重算补丁并 `reconcile` 到运行中的 loader，同样不需要重启——本插件第一次加载就是这么上线的（加完 bundles 条目 2 秒后页面就拉到了 bundle）。

```sh
npm test          # 41 项，纯 node:test，无依赖
```

测试覆盖纯逻辑（目标集合计算、分栏读取、固定集合读取、图钉样式表）、注册接线、组件渲染出的行与点击顺序，以及在假 DOM 上跑的图钉装饰器安装/标记/回收。

## 为什么这么写

dsh 右侧栏的标签菜单只有一个扩展位：`sidebar.right.tab.menu.item`，需要 `sidebarRight` 服务，并且**不允许**插件拿到分栏的标签列表——`ctx.sidebarRight` 上只有 `close` / `focus` / `openTab` 这些动作，没有任何读取接口。

所以这个插件从三个公开契约上取信息：

- **菜单内容**走 `sidebar.right.tab.menu.item` 席位，菜单行用共享原件 `MenuItemButton` 渲染（它本身就是 `role="menuitem"`，dsh 靠这个角色判断菜单是不是空的）。
- **分栏里的标签顺序**从 chip 的标记读：`[data-dockkit-tab]` 在 `[data-dockkit-strip-tabs]` 里的文档顺序，也就是 dsh 自己读自己那一行 chip 的方式。
- **当前会话**从 `[data-sidebar-right-session]` 读，用来定位这个会话自己的固定集合。

固定集合存在插件自己的一个 `defineStore` 里（会话作用域 + `persist`），组件通过 store 席位读写，装饰器读自己那个 localStorage 键。

plugins.description: dsh-tool-tsfork — part of the hy-sde/dsh-plugins monorepo (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.readme_text:
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:START -->
> [!NOTE]
> 📦 This plugin lives in the [**dsh-plugins**](https://github.com/hy-sde/dsh-plugins) monorepo — file issues & pull requests there.
> npm: [`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork)
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:END -->

# dsh-tool-tsfork — Go-native TypeScript compiler devices for DeepSeek Harness

A standalone package, installable as **one plugin** (two device tools) for the
DeepSeek Harness: model-facing devices over a **parked Go-native TypeScript
compiler** — the [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)
perf fork (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, TS `7.1.0-dev`). `tsfork_status`
reports the binary, version banner and build stamp; `tsfork_check` runs
one-shot `-b` project-graph checks with parsed diagnostics, wall time, and a
GOMAXPROCS cap. The compiler binary is built once and parked on the host; the
plugin only speaks the harness device seam — zero upstream harness changes.

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` |
| Plugin id | `hy-sde-tsfork` |
| Devices | `tsfork_status` · `tsfork_check` (device-catalog tools via `dyn`) |

> **Based on [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)**
> (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, a Go rewrite of
> [microsoft/TypeScript](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript), Apache-2.0
> lineage): no compiler code is ported or modified — this package is original
> plugin code that spawns the binary once per call over a stable CLI contract
> (`tsc -b`, JSON-free default output). Adapted, not ported: the harness
> device seam (`device: true` tools via `ctx.tools` + `ctx.systemPrompt`)
> exists so a deployment can expose a fast compiler without touching the
> repo's pinned toolchain. See
> [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

## Why

The type gate on a large workspace is the stock `tsc -b` over the whole
solution graph — on the fork harness's 337-project host graph that was
**54.25s cold** (91.6s CPU, 4.6GB peak), and every agent that wants a
typecheck pays it serially. The Go compiler checks the same graph
byte-identically (project listings, 14/14 planted errors, deterministic
output) in **7.05s cold / ~0.6s warm** — 7.7× less wall time, 3.4× less CPU.
But nothing in a harness exposes it: gates run through `pnpm` scripts pinned
to `typescript@6.0.3`, and a plugin cannot replace a repo's own toolchain —
nor should it, because oxlint `typeAware` and the typert generator need the
JS API that TS 7 (a Go binary) does not ship. What agents need is a *device*
pointing at a parked binary: loadable per deployment, unloadable by toggling
one row, structured output, no PATH tricks, no upstream changes — while the
pinned toolchain stays exactly as pinned.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js **22.19 or newer** (the package's `engines` floor) with pnpm on `PATH`;
- a DeepSeek Harness installation with the device catalog (the package's peer
  baseline is `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.5-alpha.1`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`
  `^0.2.1-alpha.2`; registries without the device concept simply present the
  tools eagerly);
- a tsfork compiler binary parked on the host (default `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc`)
  with a `VERSION` stamp beside it — build it once from a checkout of the
  fork:

  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript.ts.git typescript.ts   # or your fork
  cd typescript.ts && git checkout perf/checker-speedups-v3
  go build -o ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc ./cmd/tsc        # inside the tsc/ dir of the checkout
  printf 'source: can1357/TypeScript perf/checker-speedups-v3 @ <commit>\n' > ~/.dsh/tsfork/VERSION
  ```

  (the Go tree ships its generated files — no generate step; Go 1.27+)

## Quick start

### Route A — published npm package (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

> Publishing after the Shape-A trial — until then use Route B.

### Route B — from source (validate this checkout or hack on the plugin)

```bash
git clone git@github.com:hy-sde/dsh-plugins.git
cd dsh-plugins/dsh-tool-tsfork/packages/tool-tsfork
pnpm install
PACKAGE_TARBALL="$(pnpm pack | tail -n 1)"
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/$PACKAGE_TARBALL"
cd ../../../..
```

Deployment variant used for the trial (no `dsh` CLI on PATH, hand-managed
profile): link the built package into the profile with an absolute `file:`
path — `pnpm add file:<abs-path-to-package>` in the profile dir, then add
`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The package's own
`dsh.bundle.patch` mounts the `hy-sde-tsfork` row.

### Verify the composed configuration

```bash
dsh web --dump-config
```

### Run

Start the harness (`dsh web`) and ask the agent to check or probe a graph.
The model-facing calls (device catalog — `dyn search tsfork`):

- `tsfork_status` (no arguments) — resolved binary, `Version 7.1.0-dev`
  banner, build stamp from `<binaryDir>/VERSION`, 20s health probe.
- `tsfork_check` — `tsc -b <project>`; returns `exitCode`, `wallMs`,
  `errorCount`/`warningCount`, parsed `diagnostics` (`file:line:col TSxxxx`),
  an `outputTail`, and a reproducible `command`. `dry: true` prepends
  `--dry` (list the projects a build would run, without building). Pass
  `cwd` (and `project`) explicitly outside the deployment's default checkout.

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

## What the bundle does

The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` mounts **one plain agent-plane row**
(`hy-sde-tsfork`) that consumes the deployment's host services — `tools` and
`systemPrompt` (the stock agent bundle provides both). No service, realm, or
filesystem seam of its own: each call spawns the parked compiler once, so
concurrent agent lanes are isolated by construction and the only shared-box
knob is GOMAXPROCS. It also registers the `tsfork:tools` prompt section,
which documents the buildinfo gotcha and the adoption boundary to every
session that mounts the device.

## Engine behavior

- **One-shot spawn, stdin closed.** Every call is `spawn(binary, argv)` with
  `stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']` — the compiler never reads stdin, and
  a held-open pipe is the classic CLI-wrapper hang.
- **Flag order.** The Go parser requires `-b`/`--build` to precede the
  project path; post-project flags (`--dry`, …) are accepted after it. A
  bare `tsc <tsconfig>` (no `-b`) fails with TS5112 — the plugin always
  sends `-b` first.
- **Timeout semantics.** SIGTERM at `timeoutMs`, SIGKILL 5s later — the
  escalation is scheduled *by* the timeout, never at spawn. A timed-out run
  resolves with `timedOut: true` and the partial output instead of rejecting.
- **Output caps.** stdout/stderr are captured up to `maxOutputBytes` per
  side (default 4 MiB, flagged `outputTruncated`); diagnostics are capped at
  500 with exact counts kept beyond the cap (`diagnosticsTruncated`).
- **`.tsbuildinfo` is compiler-version-tagged.** Alternating `tsfork_check`
  with the repo's stock `tsc -b` invalidates the other side's incremental
  caches — runs go cold. The prompt section warns agents; pick a primary
  and accept the other side paying one cold run.
- **Adoption boundary.** tsfork does not replace the pinned `typescript@6.0.3`
  toolchain: oxlint `typeAware` and typert need the JS API (TS 7's npm
  package is a launcher shim with no `lib/typescript.js`). Promotion, if the
  trial proves out, is a `pnpm` override of the gate binary — not this
  plugin.

## Configuration

| Option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` | `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc` | Compiler binary (expandable `~`), must be executable |
| `defaultProject` | — | `-b` project used when a call omits `project` |
| `defaultCwd` | — | Working directory used when a call omits `cwd` |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` | Per-call process timeout |
| `gomaxprocs` | — | `GOMAXPROCS` written to the child env (lane-friendly parallelism cap) |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `4000000` | Cap on captured stdout/stderr bytes per side |

```yaml
- id: hy-sde-tsfork
  config:
    binary: ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc
    defaultProject: tsconfig.host.json
    defaultCwd: /path/to/your/checkout
    timeoutMs: 900000
    gomax

# CaSee 市场情报分析专家 · DSH 插件 *由 CaSee 凯见情报平台驱动 —— 把 500+ 可信信源变成一名可溯源的市场情报分析师*

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) *** ## 关于 CaSee —— AI 驱动的竞争情报平台 **CaSee（凯见）** 是 AI 驱动的**竞争情报与市场洞察平台** —— 「谋定而后动，见微知著，决胜千里」。 CaSee 提供**可信信源竞争情报**，帮助创业公司发现市场机会、帮助成熟企业扩大竞争优势。它解决企业竞争情报的核心痛点： - 情报采集碎片化 - 人工分析低效 - 市场洞察滞后 - 情报无法进入业务决策 面向中大型企业的市场、销售、产品与战略团队，CaSee 把市场数据与业务决策连接起来 —— 从**被动竞争监测**升级为**主动市场趋势预判**。 ### 平台能力 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **实时竞争感知** | 针对具体业务线监测竞品、市场与客户；全景式外部环境扫描；分级实时威胁预警 | | **量化竞争威胁分析** | SWOT、PESTEL、BCG 矩阵、VRIO 框架等系统化分析工具，评估行业盈利性、竞争格局与政策风险 | | **主动策略评估** | 自研神经-因果 AI 长链因果推理引擎，预测竞争策略效果 —— 开放世界推理长链因果，封闭世界推理量化执行结果 | | **可信情报采集** | 实时竞品追踪、市场趋势预测、碎片化情报融合、目标导向的定向情报感知 | | **专家竞争分析** | 定制化 CI 分析能力建设、自助式专业报告、行业专家知识库 | > **可信情报保障**：量化 T-Score 可信度评分、多源交叉验证、因果推理偏差检测与合规护栏，防止 AI 幻觉、过期数据与虚假引用。 > **试用 CaSee**： —— 注册并获取 API 密钥。 *** ## 🎯 这是什么 `dsh-plugin-market-intelligence` 是面向 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的市场情报分析专家插件（一个 `dsh.bundle` 包）。装入后，它向当前 profile 贡献三件东西，把 CaSee 情报能力直接变成模型可调用的原生能力： | 贡献 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | **6 个模型可调用工具** | `find_trusted_sources`、`search_intelligence`、`analyze_trend`、`aggregate_by_source`、`search_with_cvc`、`semantic_search` | | **专家人格段落** | 注册为 system prompt 的 `market-intelligence:expert` 段（order 5）：分析师角色、三条铁律、T-Score/ABCD 分级、检索方法与双格式输出契约 | | **内置技能** | `market-intelligence` 技能（`ctx.skills` 运行时注册）：核心流程、检索策略、市场工作流、报告模板与 **HTML 报告样式规范** | > **取数通道说明**：插件直连 CaSee **REST** 接口（`/v1/sources/search`、`/v1/searchx`、`/v1/semantic-search`）。它与 `causalai.me:8100` 的 MCP 端点是**两条独立通道**，互不依赖。 *** ## 🤖 为什么用它 把竞争情报做进 agent 通常意味着：自己接 HTTP、做字段映射、去重、统计、缓存、调度、安全审查，再自造一套报告样式 —— 每个信源、每个产品都要重来一遍。 `dsh-plugin-market-intelligence` 把这些变成**一次安装 + 一套契约**： | 维度 | 手工集成 | 用本插件 | | --- | --- | --- | | **首个可用分析** | 数天（后端 + 前端 + 胶水） | 一次 `dsh plugin add` | | **数据可信度** | 自行判断来源真伪 | 每条情报自带 T-Score + ABCD 分级，可溯源 | | **检索能力** | 自建搜索与过滤 | 类 Google 查询语法 + 两阶段可信检索 + CVC 语义检索 | | **报告交付** | 自己写模板与图表 | 内置 CaSee 深色看板规范（appbar/封面/目录/编号章节/ECharts/来源附录） | | **幻觉风险** | 全靠提示词自律 | 工具层 + 人格层双重「零编造」约束 | > **核心价值**：市场情报能力变成**可安装、可配置、可复现**的 Harness 能力，且报告规范与 CaSee 官方报告同款。 *** ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 前置条件 - **Node.js ≥ 22.19**（DSH 运行时要求） - **DeepSeek Harness `dsh` ≥ 0.1.0-rc.6**（`dsh --version` 可查） - **CaSee API 密钥** —— 到 免费注册后获取 ### 第 1 步 —— 安装 ```bash # A. npm（推荐，包名即身份） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-market-intelligence # B. GitHub 仓库 dsh plugin --profile web add github:xcasee/dsh-plugin-market-intelligence # C. tarball（离线 / 评审分发） dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-market-intelligence-1.0.0.tgz ``` 重启 `dsh web`。 ### 第 2 步 —— 确认插件层已生效 ```bash dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A6 market-intelligence ``` 应能看到： ``` # == dsh-plugin-market-intelligence - id: market-intelligence name: dsh-plugin-market-intelligence config: apiBaseUrl: http://121.43.113.132:8000 ... ``` ### 第 3 步 —— 配置 API 密钥 密钥**只从环境变量读取，绝不写入配置文件**： ```bash export CASEE_API_KEY=<你的密钥> ``` 然后**新开一个对话**（工具绑定发生在会话创建时）。 ### 第 4 步 —— 直接提问 ``` 追踪比亚迪最近 30 天在新能源汽车领域的竞争动态 分析近 90 天 AI 芯片行业趋势，只看 T-Score 0.8 以上的信源 调研中国人形机器人行星滚柱丝杠的市场规模、格局与进入机会 ``` *** ## ⚙️ 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）按 `id` 覆盖。**补丁整块替换 `config`，需重述全部要保留的键**： ```yaml - id: market-intelligence config: apiBaseUrl: 'http://121.43.113.132:8000' apiKeyEnv: CASEE_API_KEY defaultDays: 30 defaultMinTscore: 0.6 maxLimit: 200 timeoutMs: 30000 requestIntervalMs: 200 registerSkill: true registerPrompt: true platformUrl: 'https://casee.me' outputLanguage: auto ``` | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiBaseUrl` | `http://121.43.113.132:8000` | CaSee REST 基地址（**非** 8100 MCP 端口） | | `apiKeyEnv` | `CASEE_API_KEY` | 读取密钥的环境变量名 | | `defaultDays` | `30` | 默认时间窗口（天） | | `defaultMinTscore` | `0.6` | 默认可信度门槛 | | `maxLimit` | `200` | 单次请求条数上限 | | `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单请求超时（毫秒） | | `requestIntervalMs` | `200` | 出站请求最小间隔（毫秒），`0` 关闭限速 | | `registerSkill` | `true` | 是否注册内置技能 | | `registerPrompt` | `true` | 是否注册专家人格段落 | | `platformUrl` | `https://casee.me` | 报告 CTA 与取密钥引导链接 | | `outputLanguage` | `auto` | 报告语言：`auto`（跟随用户）/`zh`/`en` | *** ## 💬 使用 ### 六个情报工具 | 工具 | 用途 | 关键参数 | | --- | --- | --- | | `find_trusted_sources` | 按类别/地区/语言/可信度发现可信信源 | `category`、`min_tscore`、`limit` | | `search_intelligence` | 在可信信源子集内做类 Google 语法检索（主力） | `q`、`source_ids`、`days`、`min_tscore` | | `analyze_trend` | 按日/月聚合声量，找峰值与催化点 | `q`、`days` | | `aggregate_by_source` | 按信源统计报道量、平均可信度与样例标题 | `q`、`days` | | `search_with_cvc` | 检索并把命中归集到 CVC 向量模型 | `q`、`cvc_model_id` | | `semantic_search` | CVC 语义检索（BM25 + 向量 + RRF，跨语种） | `cvc_model_id`、`q`、`mode` | ### 查询语法（`q`） | 运算符 | 含义 | 示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `+word` | AND | `+AI +芯片` | | `-word` | NOT | `+电动车 -自行车` | | `a\|b` | 同义 OR | `电动车\|EV\|NEV` | | `"phrase"` | 精确短语 | `"market share"` | | `(...)` | 分组 | `+(特斯拉\|Tesla) +(交付\|销量)` | 中文关键词由平台自动翻译为英文检索，返回 `translated_keywords` 供核对。 ### 输出契约 每次分析**同时**产出两部分，不可二选一： 1. **对话内 Markdown 摘要** —— 一句话结论 + 3–5 条关键发现（每条附 T-Score + 信源名 + 日期 + 可点链接） 2. **完整 HTML 报告文件** —— CaSee 深色看板：appbar → 封面（4 指标卡）→ 吸顶目录 → 00 结论先行 → 编号章节（含 ECharts 图表 / SWOT / 时间线 / 矩阵）→ 来源附录（编号来源 + T-Score 徽章） *** ## 🛡 T-Score 可信度体系 | T-Score | 等级 | 标识 | 使用纪律 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | ≥ 0.8 | A | 🟢 | 可直接作为决策依据 | | 0.6–0.8 | B | 🟡 | 结合上下文使用 | | 0.4–0.6 | C | 🔴 | 信号参考，必须交叉验证 | | < 0.4 | D | ⚪ | 视为传言，不作事实陈述 | **ABCD 信源分级**：A=通讯社/官方；B=主流权威；C=垂直媒体/博客；D=UGC/论坛。 *** ## 🧩 工程结构 ``` dsh-plugin-market-intelligence/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle 清单 + 依赖 + 脚本 ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle 补丁层（插入 market-intelligence 行） ├── tsconfig.json ├── src/ │ ├── index.ts # 插件入口：name / inject / Config / apply │ ├── config.ts # Schemastery 配置 schema │ ├── casee-client.ts # CaSee REST 客户端（归一化 + 限速 + 超时 + 错误码） │ ├── errors.ts # 结构化错误 │ ├── types.ts # 规范返回值类型 │ ├── prompt.ts # 专家人格 system-prompt 段落 │ ├── skill.ts # 运行时技能注册 │ └── tools/ # 6 个工具 + 共享 schema/渲染 ├── assets/skills/market-intelligence/ │ ├── SKILL.md # 技能正文 │ └── analysis/ # 核心流程 / 检索策略 / 市场工作流 / 报告模板 / 报告样式规范 ├── tests/ # 仿真测试（mock REST + 全流程 + 报告断言） └── .github/workflows/publish.yml # tag 触发的自动发布 ``` ### 开发命令 ```bash npm install # 构建依赖（@deepseek-ai/* 为 optional peer + devDependency） npm run typecheck # 类型检查 npm run build # 产出 lib/ npm test # 仿真测试：装载冒烟 + mock CaSee REST 全流程 + 报告断言 npm pack # 产出 dsh-plugin-market-intelligence-1.0.0.tgz ``` `npm test` 会启动进程内 mock CaSee REST 服务，用**真实插件代码**跑完整流水线，校验 6 个工具、正/负路径（`AUTH_REQUIRED` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT` / `HTTP_ERROR`）、方法学结论（Niche Go / Watch / No-Go 与否决闸门）与报告产物。产物落在 `tests/output/`。 *** ## 🩺 排错 | 现象 | 原因 | 处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | `AUTH_REQUIRED` | 未配置或密钥无效 | 到 取密钥，`export CASEE_API_KEY=...` 后**新开对话** | | `NETWORK_ERROR` / `TIMEOUT` | 端点不通或过慢 | 核对 `apiBaseUrl` 与出站网络；必要时调大 `timeoutMs` | | `RATE_LIMITED` | 调用过快 | 降低并发（≤100 次/分钟）或调大 `requestIntervalMs` | | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `cvc_model_id` 不合规 | 使用 `^cvc_[a-z0-9]{8,32}$`，如 `cvc_battery_anxiety` | | 工具未出现 | 未装插件 / 未重启 | `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 确认层，重启 `dsh web` | *** ## 📦 发布 ```bash npm version patch git tag v1.0.1 && git push origin v1.0.1 # 触发 .github/workflows/publish.yml ``` CI 需要仓库 Secret `NPM_TOKEN`（npm **Automation** token）。仅预演可手动运行 workflow 且不勾选 publish。

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: DSH Web 全局皮肤插件：图片/视频背景铺满界面，面板半透明可调 | Global image/video background skin for DSH Web
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skin-live

把一张图片或一段视频铺满整个 DSH Web 界面 —— **只改背景，不动布局**。 插件在页面最底层挂一个固定画布，把应用本身的底色透明化，于是主区域和侧栏共用同一张背景；卡片、输入框、弹层仍留在原位置、原尺寸，只是变成了半透明玻璃。所有参数存在浏览器本地，素材不上传、不联网。 - 图片：`PNG` `JPG` `JPEG` `WebP` `GIF` `AVIF` `BMP` `SVG` - 视频：`MP4` `WebM` `OGV` `MOV` `M4V` `MKV`（静音、循环、自动播放） - 也可以直接填一个图片 / 视频 URL，素材不用下载到本地 - 四项独立调节：面板不透明度、素材不透明度、模糊、暗化 - 停用或卸载插件后，背景层被移除、主题变量还原，界面回到默认外观 ## 目录 - [安装](#安装) - [使用](#使用) - [参数说明](#参数说明) - [兼容范围](#兼容范围) - [卸载与回滚](#卸载与回滚) - [数据与隐私](#数据与隐私) - [与其它皮肤插件共存](#与其它皮肤插件共存) - [本地开发](#本地开发) - [许可](#许可) ## 安装 DSH 自带插件管理器，三种来源都支持。**任选一种即可，不需要手改配置文件。** ### 方式一：Web 插件页（推荐，不用命令行） 1. 打开 DSH Web 界面（默认 ）。 2. 左侧栏进入 **插件**（Plugins）页。 3. 在安装输入框里粘贴下面这一行，确认安装： ``` github:zhaochaorui-study/dsh-skin-live ``` 4. 安装完成后插件会默认启用；如果列表里显示未启用，手动打开它的开关。 5. 刷新页面（`Cmd/Ctrl + R`），设置里就会出现「皮肤」。 ### 方式二：命令行 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhaochaorui-study/dsh-skin-live ``` 发布到 npm 之后，也可以直接用包名： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skin-live ``` > `--profile web` 是目标 profile 名。桌面版换用 `--profile desktop`（尚未验证）。 ### 方式三：离线安装包 `.tgz` 不想联网或想固定版本时，从 [Releases](https://github.com/zhaochaorui-study/dsh-skin-live/releases) 下载 `dsh-skin-live-1.0.0.tgz`，然后： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-skin-live-1.0.0.tgz ``` 也可以在插件页选择这个本地文件安装。 ### 验证安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web list | grep dsh-skin-live dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 'dsh-skin-live' ``` 预期能看到 `dsh-skin-live` 这一条依赖，以及一个 `id: dsh-skin-live` 的加载项。 ## 使用 界面里的路径是 **设置 → 皮肤**。 1. **选择背景** —— 点「选择文件」上传，或把图片 / 视频直接拖进虚线框；也可以在输入框里粘贴素材 URL。 2. **调节参数** —— 按下面的表格拖动滑块，画面实时变化。 3. **自动保存** —— 参数写入 `localStorage`，素材写入 `IndexedDB`，刷新或重启 DSH 后自动恢复。 首版的完整流程就是这三步：**安装插件 → 选择背景 → 调整模糊和暗化**。 ## 参数说明 | 控件 | 范围 | 作用 | | --- | --- | --- | | 启用皮肤 | 开 / 关 | 临时关掉背景层并还原主题，素材和参数都保留，随时开回来 | | 背景来源 | 文件 / URL | 本地文件存进 `IndexedDB`；URL 每次加载时直接引用 | | 铺满方式 | 铺满 / 完整 / 拉伸 | 对应 `object-fit: cover / contain / fill` | | 面板不透明度 | 0–100% | 只作用于卡片、输入框、弹层等面板表面；0% 为全透明，100% 为当前主题原色 | | 素材不透明度 | 10–100% | 背景图片 / 视频本身的透明度 | | 模糊 | 0–40px | 只模糊背景层，文字保持清晰（模糊时自动放大 6% 避免边缘露白） | | 暗化 | 0–80% | 在背景上叠一层黑色蒙版，深色主题下更好读 | 侧栏属于全局背景画布，所以它跟随背景显示；「面板不透明度」不会把它单独盖掉。 ## 兼容范围 | 环境 | 状态 | | --- | --- | | DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` + Web / PWA | ✅ 已实测 | | DSH Desktop（`--profile desktop`） | ⚠️ 未验证，按需自行确认 | | 更早的 DSH 版本 | 未验证；插件依赖 `slots` / `theme` / `locale` 三个客户端服务 | 实现上刻意**不声明 `peerDependencies`**，避免 DSH 运行时升级后出现版本互斥拒绝安装；服务缺失或接口变化时，插件会退化为无背景，不会影响主界面正常使用。 主题相关的实现依赖 DSH 的主题服务（`theme.overrideTokens`）、调色板变量（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-specific-*`）和插槽 / 语言服务，DSH 升级后如果变量被重命名，面板不透明度会回落到主题默认值（不会出现错误颜色）。 ## 卸载与回滚 **停用（保留数据）**：插件页关掉开关，或在设置里关掉「启用皮肤」——背景立刻还原，参数和素材都还在。 **彻底卸载**： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-skin-live ``` 然后在插件页确认它已从列表消失，刷新页面。卸载后 `localStorage` / `IndexedDB` 里的参数与素材可以手动清理： ```js // 浏览器开发者工具 Console localStorage.removeItem('dsh-skin-live:settings:v1'); indexedDB.deleteDatabase('dsh-skin-live:media'); ``` ## 数据与隐私 - 参数：`localStorage` 键 `dsh-skin-live:settings:v1` - 素材：`IndexedDB` 库 `dsh-skin-live:media`，对象仓库 `blobs`，键 `current` - 插件不发起任何网络请求，也不上报数据。填 URL 时，素材由浏览器按该地址直接加载。 从早期本地版 `@local/dsh-skin-live` 升级过来时，旧键 `@local/dsh-skin-live:settings:v1` 和旧库 `@local/dsh-skin-live:media` 里的内容会被自动沿用并复制一份到新名字下；旧数据不会被删除，方便回退到旧版本。 ## 与其它皮肤插件共存 如果同时装了另一套皮肤系统（例如 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center`），两边都会改写背景和主题变量，会互相覆盖。建议只保留一套。 ## 本地开发 仓库结构： ``` . ├── package.json # dsh 清单：bundle patch、client 入口、注入的客户端服务 ├── index.js # Host 半边：只提供 Loader 条目，不做事 ├── client.js # Client 半边：背景层、主题 token、设置页（全部逻辑） ├── client.test.js # 回归测试（node:test + 最小 DOM/IndexedDB 夹具） ├── cordis.patch.yml # 插件挂载声明 ├── locale/ # 设置页文案 └── icon.svg # 插件图标 ``` 跑检查： ```bash npm run check # 两个入口的语法检查 npm test # 9 项回归测试 npm pack # 产出可安装的 .tgz ``` 手工 link 到本机 profile 调试、以及从旧版本迁移本机配置的完整步骤，见 [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)。 ### 设计取舍 - 背景层是 `position: fixed; z-index: -1` 且 `pointer-events: none` 的独立节点，挂在 `document.body` 上 —— 这是既能垫在整个应用之下、又不影响页面原有布局的唯一位置。 - 面板半透明走主题变量覆盖（`theme.overrideTokens`），逐个 token 读取当前主题的真实色值再混入透明度；主题没定义的 token 直接跳过，而不是猜一个颜色。 - 所有副作用都挂在 `ctx.effect` 上，插件卸载时移除 DOM、撤销 token 覆盖、释放对象 URL。 - 插件本体很轻（几十 KB），不带任何素材；皮肤素材由用户自己提供，因此安装包可以保持小体积。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 密钥轮换：查密钥与证书多久没换、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate)


**关键词**：密钥轮换 · 密钥管理 · 证书轮换 · 证书过期 · 密钥过期 · 密码周期 · 密钥复用
**Keywords**: key rotation · secret rotation · certificate rotation · key management · cryptoperiod
**密钥轮换** —— 查密钥与证书多久没换了、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 `id_rsa` 是两年前配的，一直没动。制度文档也许写了「密钥每年轮换」。

**但事实上它就是没换过。**

等保测评会问「鉴别信息多久更换一次」，客户尽调会问「密钥管理流程」——
你拿不出证据，因为**文件时间戳就摆在那里**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 密钥/证书文件超过一年未更新（按 mtime）|
| 🟡 中 | 文档里找不到轮换策略 |
| 🟡 中 | 同一密钥在多个环境配置里被引用 |

## 为什么这是可判定的

```
密钥文件 mtime → 距今多少天 → 对比阈值（默认 365 天）
```

制度写在纸上，**时间戳不会说谎**。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-key-rotate --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-key-rotate --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-key-rotate --html r.html
```

![dsh-key-rotate 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/report.png)

![dsh-key-rotate 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/demo.png)

![dsh-key-rotate 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/rules.png)

## 边界

- **年龄 ≠ 未轮换** —— 密钥可能在 KMS 里，本地只是副本。报出来需你确认。
- **不解析证书内容** —— 不校验有效期、签发者、密钥长度。
- **跨环境复用只看 .env 类文件** —— KMS / CI secrets 看不到。
- 与 [dsh-bundle-cn-skills](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-bundle-cn-skills) 分工：那个查「密钥有没有被提交」，这个查「多久没换」。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [**密钥轮换**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen.svg) ![pnpm](https://img.shields.io/badge/pnpm-10.33.2-orange.svg) ![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-blueviolet.svg)

> 仓库地址：<https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-plugins>

DeepSeek Harness 插件集合（monorepo）。

从 8 个独立仓库合并而来，**完整保留 173 个 commit 的历史**（用 `git filter-repo` 重写路径 + `git merge --allow-unrelated-histories`）。

## 结构

```
dsh-plugins/
├── package.json              # private 根，pnpm workspace
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml       # packages/*
├── PLUGIN-CONTRACT.md        # 插件开发契约（跨插件共享）
├── THEME-CONTRACT.md         # 主题与令牌契约
└── packages/
    ├── dsh-context-memory/   # 每个仍是独立 npm 包
    ├── dsh-cost-track/
    ├── dsh-model-arena/
    ├── dsh-prompt-vcs/
    ├── dsh-spill-hygiene/
    ├── dsh-step-trace/
    ├── dsh-theme-studio/
    ├── dsh-tool-stats/
    └── dsh-verdict/
```

## 插件

| 插件 | npm 版本 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| dsh-context-memory | `0.6.1` | pre-step 捕获显式记忆语句，注入 top-5 相关记忆 + 未决冲突 |
| dsh-verdict | `0.5.1` | 评审/校验流水线（guard、pipeline、promote、schedule、skills） |
| dsh-theme-studio | `0.6.3` | 主题工作室（tokens、apply、io、themes） |
| dsh-cost-track | `0.5.1` | 成本追踪 + 计价 |
| dsh-model-arena | `0.5.1` | 模型竞技场（arena、diff、scoring） |
| dsh-prompt-vcs | `0.5.1` | 提示词版本控制 |
| dsh-step-trace | `0.5.1` | 单步追踪回放 |
| dsh-tool-stats | `0.5.1` | 工具调用统计 |
| dsh-spill-hygiene | `0.1.0` | 回收 dsh 自家 spill 清理看不见（根前缀 + 目录形态双重失配）的子进程 spill 残留；默认只报告，`--apply` 才删 |

## 常用命令

```powershell
# 安装全部依赖（共享一份 node_modules）
pnpm install

# 构建 / 测试 / 类型检查（全部包）
pnpm build
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck

# 只操作某个包
pnpm --filter dsh-verdict build
pnpm --filter dsh-verdict test

# 发某一个包
cd packages\dsh-verdict
npm publish

# 一次性发所有包（版本已各自 bump 后）
pnpm -r publish
```

## 收益

| | 合并前 | 合并后 |
|---|---|---|
| `node_modules` | 375.3 MB（8 份重复） | 52.9 MB（1 份共享） |
| 依赖安装 | `cd` 8 次 `npm install` | 根目录一次 `pnpm install` |
| CI | 8 份相同 `ci.yml` | 1 份 |
| 发全部 | 重复 8 次 | `pnpm -r publish` |

各包的 `name` / `version` / `files` / `dsh` 字段与 `peerDependencies` **完全未变**，npm 用户装到的内容一致。

## 修订契约时

契约条款必须来自对**运行时**的实际核验。当前基准 `0.2.0-rc.2`：

```powershell
$g = "$env:APPDATA\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
$d = "C:\Users\12925\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
$g\dsh-plugin-manager\README.zh.md   # 第 9 章的一手来源
```

## 已知测试失败（合并前既有，非合并导致）

- `dsh-context-memory`：3 个失败
- `dsh-verdict`：9 个失败

均已在备份的原仓库上复现同一组失败，见 `git log` 中 `packages/` 下的历史。
